```{r}
    message("Installing package: ", pkg)
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# CondenScreen GUI 
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Function to generate well coordinates
generate_well_coordinates <- function(rows, cols) {
  expand.grid(Row = LETTERS[1:rows], Col = 1:cols) %>%
    mutate(
      Col = as.integer(Col),
      Well = paste0(Row, sprintf("%02d", Col)),
      Condition = "None"
    )
}

# ---------------------------
# UI
# ---------------------------
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("CondenScreen Well Selection:"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        "plate_type", "Select Plate Type:",
        choices = c(
          "6-well"   = "2x3",
          "12-well"  = "3x4",
          "24-well"  = "4x6",
          "96-well"  = "8x12",
          "384-well" = "16x24"
        )
      ),

      radioButtons(
        "condition", "Select Condition:",
        choices = c("Positive Control", "Negative Control", "Test Condition", "Unselect")
      ),

      textInput("pos_control_name", "Positive Control Name:", value = "Positive Ctrl"),
      textInput("neg_control_name", "Negative Control Name:", value = "Negative Ctrl"),

      # NEW: Chemical vs Genetic screen toggle (button)
      actionButton("screen_toggle", "Screen: Chemical", style = "width: 100%"),

      # Existing: signal toggle
      actionButton("signal_toggle", "Signal: OFF", style = "width: 100%"),

      actionButton("clear", "Clear Selections"),
      hr(),

      strong("Save Directory:"),
      div(
        style = "display: flex; margin-bottom: 10px;",
        textInput("save_dir", NULL, value = paste0(getwd(), "/"), width = "100%")
      ),

      textInput(
        "save_filename",
        "Save File Name: (end with .csv; Final analysis will be in YOURFILENAME_results.csv)",
        value = "well_selection.csv"
      ),

      strong("Input Directory:"),
      div(
        style = "display: flex; margin-bottom: 10px;",
        textInput("input_dir", NULL, value = paste0(getwd(), "/"), width = "100%"),
        actionButton("parent_input_dir", "↑", style = "margin-left: 5px;"),
        actionButton("reset_input_dir", "Reset", style = "margin-left: 5px;")
      ),

      hr(),
      downloadButton("download", "Download Selection"),
      actionButton("exit_app", "Exit", class = "btn-danger", style = "width: 100%;")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("plate_plot"),
      tableOutput("selected_wells")
    )
  )
)

# ---------------------------
# SERVER
# ---------------------------
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Reactive values for directories (metadata)
  save_dir <- reactiveVal(getwd())
  input_dir <- reactiveVal(file.path(getwd(), "data"))

  observeEvent(input$save_dir, {
    if (dir.exists(input$save_dir)) save_dir(input$save_dir)
  })

  observeEvent(input$input_dir, {
    if (dir.exists(input$input_dir)) input_dir(input$input_dir)
  })

  observeEvent(input$parent_input_dir, {
    current <- input_dir()
    parent <- dirname(current)
    input_dir(parent)
    updateTextInput(session, "input_dir", value = parent)
  })

  observeEvent(input$reset_input_dir, {
    default <- file.path(getwd(), "data")
    input_dir(default)
    updateTextInput(session, "input_dir", value = default)
  })

  # Plate dimensions
  plate_dims <- reactive({
    dims <- strsplit(input$plate_type, "x")[[1]]
    list(rows = as.integer(dims[1]), cols = as.integer(dims[2]))
  })

  # Main data store
  well_data <- reactiveVal(data.frame(Row = character(), Col = integer(), Well = character(), Condition = character()))

  # Initialize / regenerate on plate type changes
  observeEvent(input$plate_type, {
    dims <- plate_dims()
    df <- generate_well_coordinates(dims$rows, dims$cols)
    well_data(df)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  observe({
    if (nrow(well_data()) == 0) {
      dims <- plate_dims()
      df <- generate_well_coordinates(dims$rows, dims$cols)
      well_data(df)
    }
  })

  # Chemical vs Genetic toggle
  screen_type <- reactiveVal("Chemical")
  observeEvent(input$screen_toggle, {
    screen_type(ifelse(screen_type() == "Chemical", "Genetic", "Chemical"))
    updateActionButton(session, "screen_toggle", label = paste0("Screen: ", screen_type()))
  })

  # Signal toggle
  signal_status <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  observeEvent(input$signal_toggle, {
    signal_status(!signal_status())
    updateActionButton(session, "signal_toggle",
                       label = ifelse(signal_status(), "Signal: ON", "Signal: OFF"))
  })

  # Map UI condition to internal label
  normalize_condition <- function(cond) {
    if (identical(cond, "Unselect")) return("None")
    cond
  }

  # Plot
  output$plate_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- well_data()

    plot_ly(
      df,
      x = ~factor(Col, levels = sort(unique(Col))),
      y = ~factor(Row, levels = rev(unique(Row))),
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      key = ~Well,  # <<< CRITICAL: stable identity so click/select never maps to wrong well
      marker = list(
        size = 15,
        color = ~case_when(
          Condition == "Positive Control" ~ "green",
          Condition == "Negative Control" ~ "red",
          Condition == "Test Condition" ~ "black",
          TRUE ~ "gray"
        )
      ),
      source = "plateplot"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        xaxis = list(title = "Column"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Row"),
        showlegend = FALSE,
        dragmode = "select"
      )
  })

  # Box select: use key (Well) not x/y
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_selected", source = "plateplot"), {
    selected_data <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "plateplot")
    if (is.null(selected_data) || is.null(selected_data$key)) return()

    df <- well_data()
    new_cond <- normalize_condition(input$condition)
    wells_clicked <- as.character(selected_data$key)

    df$Condition[df$Well %in% wells_clicked] <- new_cond
    well_data(df)
  })

  # Click select: use key (Well) not x/y
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "plateplot"), {
    click_data <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "plateplot")
    if (is.null(click_data) || is.null(click_data$key)) return()

    df <- well_data()
    new_cond <- normalize_condition(input$condition)
    well_clicked <- as.character(click_data$key)

    df$Condition[df$Well == well_clicked] <- new_cond
    well_data(df)
  })

  # Table (with renamed controls)
  output$selected_wells <- renderTable({
    well_data() %>%
      mutate(Condition = case_when(
        Condition == "Positive Control" ~ input$pos_control_name,
        Condition == "Negative Control" ~ input$neg_control_name,
        Condition == "None" ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ Condition
      ))
  })

  # Download: includes plate dims + screen type
  output$download <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() input$save_filename,
    content = function(file) {

      df <- well_data() %>%
        mutate(Condition = case_when(
          Condition == "Positive Control" ~ input$pos_control_name,
          Condition == "Negative Control" ~ input$neg_control_name,
          Condition == "None" ~ NA_character_,
          TRUE ~ Condition
        ))

      dims <- plate_dims()

      settings_df <- data.frame(
        PlateType = input$plate_type,         # e.g. "16x24"
        PlateRows = dims$rows,
        PlateCols = dims$cols,
        PlateWells = dims$rows * dims$cols,

        ScreenType = screen_type(),           # "Chemical" / "Genetic"
        SaveDirectory = save_dir(),           # metadata
        InputDirectory = input_dir(),         # metadata
        SignalStatus = ifelse(signal_status(), "ON", "OFF"),
        PositiveControlName = input$pos_control_name,
        NegativeControlName = input$neg_control_name,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      final_df <- cbind(settings_df, df)

      # (Optional) create SaveDirectory on disk, but the browser download won't use it.
      target_dir <- save_dir()
      if (!dir.exists(target_dir)) dir.create(target_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

      write.csv(final_df, file, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  )

  # Clear selections
  observeEvent(input$clear, {
    df <- well_data()
    df$Condition <- "None"
    well_data(df)
  })

  # Exit button
  observeEvent(input$exit_app, {
    stopApp()
  })

  session$onSessionEnded(function() stopApp())
}

# Run app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
process_batch <- function(batch_row, file_Location) {
  batch_number <- batch_row$batch[[1]]

  # ── Column definitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Nuc_cols <- c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber",
                "AreaShape_Area", "AreaShape_FormFactor",
                "PathName_DAPI", "FileName_DAPI")
  
  tdTomato_cols <- c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber",
                     "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_tdTomato",
                     "Intensity_MeanIntensity_tdTomato")
  
  Cyto_cols <- c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber",
                 "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP",
                 "Intensity_MeanIntensity_GFP")
  
  GFP_cols <- c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber",
                "AreaShape_Area", "AreaShape_Compactness",
                "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP", "Intensity_MeanIntensity_GFP",
                "Parent_WholeCell", "Parent_nuclear_periphery")
  
  # ── Safe loader ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  safe_fread <- function(path, cols) {
    path <- as.character(path[[1]])  # force scalar character regardless of list/vector
    if (length(path) == 0 || is.na(path) || path == "NA" || !file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
    # SPEED: probe only the header (nrows = 0) so the second read pulls just the
    # needed columns off disk; showProgress = FALSE removes per-file console overhead.
    avail <- names(fread(path, nrows = 0, showProgress = FALSE))
    fread(path, select = intersect(cols, avail), showProgress = FALSE)
  }
  # ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  df_Nuc      <- safe_fread(batch_row$Nuc,      Nuc_cols)
  df_tdTomato <- safe_fread(batch_row$tdTomato, tdTomato_cols)
  df_Cyto     <- safe_fread(batch_row$Cyto,     Cyto_cols)
  df_GFP      <- safe_fread(batch_row$GFP,      GFP_cols)
  
  if (is.null(df_Nuc)) {
    warning("Nuclei file missing for batch ", batch_number, " -- skipping")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # ── Rename nucleus columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  setnames(df_Nuc,
           c("AreaShape_Area", "AreaShape_FormFactor"),
           c("Nuc_Area", "Nuc_FormFactor"))
  
  # ── GFP foci aggregation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(df_GFP)) {
    
    df_GFP <- df_GFP[Parent_WholeCell != 0]
    has_nuc_periphery <- "Parent_nuclear_periphery" %in% names(df_GFP)
    
    if (!is.null(df_Cyto) && "Parent_WholeCell" %in% names(df_GFP)) {
      parent_key <- "Parent_WholeCell"
      if (has_nuc_periphery) {
        df_GFP[, NucFoci  := as.integer(Parent_nuclear_periphery != 0)]
        df_GFP[, CytoFoci := as.integer(Parent_nuclear_periphery == 0)]
      } else {
        df_GFP[, NucFoci  := NA_integer_]
        df_GFP[, CytoFoci := NA_integer_]
      }
    } else if (has_nuc_periphery) {
      df_GFP     <- df_GFP[Parent_nuclear_periphery != 0]
      parent_key <- "Parent_nuclear_periphery"
      df_GFP[, NucFoci  := 1L]
      df_GFP[, CytoFoci := NA_integer_]
    } else {
      parent_key <- "Parent_WholeCell"
      df_GFP[, NucFoci  := NA_integer_]
      df_GFP[, CytoFoci := NA_integer_]
    }
    
    # Which per-focus measurement columns are actually present (failsafe if a
    # CellProfiler export is missing one). Booleans are captured by the data.table
    # j-expression below; the unused if-branch is never evaluated, so a missing
    # column is never referenced.
    has_fa <- "AreaShape_Area"                    %in% names(df_GFP)
    has_compact <- "AreaShape_Compactness"              %in% names(df_GFP)
    has_ii <- "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP" %in% names(df_GFP)
    has_mi <- "Intensity_MeanIntensity_GFP"       %in% names(df_GFP)

    # Per whole-cell aggregation. Morphology (size, form factor, integrated/mean
    # intensity) is computed over NUCLEAR foci only (which(NucFoci == 1) drops NAs);
    # cytoplasmic foci contribute a count and a TOTAL integrated-intensity sum.
    df_GFP_agg <- df_GFP[, {
      ni         <- which(NucFoci  == 1L)              # nuclear-foci row indices (NA-safe)
      cyto_known <- !all(is.na(CytoFoci))              # can we distinguish cyto foci at all?
      ci         <- if (cyto_known) which(CytoFoci == 1L) else integer(0)
      list(
        NucFoci  = length(ni),
        CytoFoci = if (cyto_known) length(ci) else NA_integer_,
        Avg_NucFoci_Area                   = if (has_fa && length(ni)) mean(AreaShape_Area[ni],                    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
        Avg_NucFoci_Compactness             = if (has_compact && length(ni)) mean(AreaShape_Compactness[ni],              na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
        Avg_NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity    = if (has_ii && length(ni)) mean(Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP[ni], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
        Avg_NucFoci_Intensity              = if (has_mi && length(ni)) mean(Intensity_MeanIntensity_GFP[ni],       na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
        Total_CytoFoci_IntegratedIntensity = if (has_ii && cyto_known) sum(Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP[ci],  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
      )
    }, by = .(ObjectNumber = get(parent_key), ImageNumber)]
  } else {
    df_GFP_agg <- NULL
  }
  
  # ── Rename Cyto columns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(df_Cyto)) {
    setnames(df_Cyto,
             c("Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_GFP", "Intensity_MeanIntensity_GFP"),
             c("IntegratedIntensity_CytoplasmGFP",  "MeanIntensity_CytoplasmGFP"))
  }
  
  # ── Set keys ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  key_cols <- c("ImageNumber", "ObjectNumber")
  for (dt in list(df_Nuc, df_Cyto, df_tdTomato, df_GFP_agg)) {
    if (!is.null(dt)) setkeyv(dt, key_cols)
  }
  
  # ── Merge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  df_merge <- copy(df_Nuc)
  
  if (!is.null(df_Cyto)) {
    df_merge <- merge(df_merge, df_Cyto, by = key_cols, all.x = TRUE)
  }
  if (!is.null(df_GFP_agg)) {
    df_merge <- merge(df_merge, df_GFP_agg, by = key_cols, all.x = TRUE)
    if ("NucFoci"  %in% names(df_merge)) df_merge[is.na(NucFoci),  NucFoci  := 0L]
    if ("CytoFoci" %in% names(df_merge)) df_merge[is.na(CytoFoci), CytoFoci := 0L]
  }
  if (!is.null(df_tdTomato)) {
    df_merge <- merge(df_merge, df_tdTomato, by = key_cols, all.x = TRUE)
  }
  
  # ── Option B: write to disk, free RAM ───────────────────────────────────────
  output_file <- file.path(file_Location, paste0("batch_", batch_number, ".csv"))
  fwrite(df_merge, output_file, na = "")
  cat("Batch", batch_number, "-- wrote", nrow(df_merge), "rows\n")
  
  return(invisible(NULL))  # no return value; output is on disk
}
```

```{r}
add_trailing_slash <- function(filePath) {
  # Replace backslashes and double slashes with forward slashes
  filePath <- gsub("\\\\+", "/", filePath)  # replaces \ and \\ with /
  filePath <- gsub("/+", "/", filePath)     # collapses multiple / into a single /

  # Ensure exactly one trailing slash
  filePath <- sub("/?$", "/", filePath)

  return(filePath)
}
```

```{r}
# STRING EXTRACTION FOR WELL/PLATE NAMING CONVENTIONS 

# Vectorized version — plate id from the PATH (PathName_*), well/site from the FILE name (FileName_*).
# Accepts BOTH folder layouts (barcode before OR after Plate_<n>) and names DP plates "DP-<n>".
extract_info_vectorized <- function(combinedDF) {

  # Plate id lives in the folder PATH; well/site live in the FILE name. Need BOTH columns.
  path_col <- intersect(c("PathName_DAPI","PathName_GFP","PathName_WholeCell","PathName_tdTomato",
                          grep("^PathName_", names(combinedDF), value = TRUE)), names(combinedDF))[1]
  file_col <- intersect(c("FileName_DAPI","FileName_GFP","FileName_WholeCell","FileName_tdTomato",
                          grep("^FileName_", names(combinedDF), value = TRUE)), names(combinedDF))[1]
  if (is.na(path_col)) stop("No PathName_* column found (needed for plate id).")
  if (is.na(file_col)) stop("No FileName_* column found (needed for well/site).")

  path <- combinedDF[[path_col]]
  file <- combinedDF[[file_col]]

  # Well + site from the FILE name:  ..._B01_s2_w1.TIF  -> well B01, site 2
  well <- str_match(file, "([A-Za-z0-9]+)_s(\\d+)_w\\d+")[, 2]
  site <- str_match(file, "_s(\\d+)_w\\d+")[, 2]

  # Plate id from the PATH's "..._Plate_<digits>..." folder. Strip the leading 8-digit
  # date and the Plate_<number> token; the alphanumeric remainder is the barcode.
  #   20260217_Plate_11950_A21252  -> A21252   (barcode AFTER plate number)
  #   20251020-A21053_Plate_11611  -> A21053   (barcode BEFORE plate number)
  #   20251027-DP-46_Plate_11640   -> DP-46
  plate_dir <- str_match(path, "([^/]*Plate_\\d+[^/]*)")[, 2]
  barcode   <- plate_dir
  barcode   <- sub("^\\d{8}[-_]", "",  barcode)     # drop leading date + separator
  barcode   <- sub("_?Plate_\\d+_?", "_", barcode)  # remove the Plate_<number> token
  barcode   <- gsub("(^_+|_+$)", "",   barcode)     # trim stray underscores
  barcode   <- ifelse(is.na(barcode) | barcode == "", NA_character_, barcode)

  # DP plates -> "DP-<number>" (per request)
  dp    <- str_match(plate_dir, "(?:^|[^A-Za-z])DP[-_ ]?(\\d+)")[, 2]
  plate <- ifelse(!is.na(dp), paste0("DP-", dp), barcode)

  tibble(plate_Num = plate, Well_Num = well, Image_Num = site)
}

# Apply
# Apply — parse ONCE per unique image (path+file), then join back to every cell.
# Running str_match on the full per-cell table (tens of millions of rows) is what hung.
key <- intersect(c("PathName_DAPI", "FileName_DAPI"), names(combined_data))
u   <- unique(combined_data[, ..key])                       # ~#images, not #cells
u[, c("plate_Num", "Well_Num", "Imagecopy_Num") := extract_info_vectorized(u)]

combined_data[u, on = key,
  `:=`(plate_Num     = i.plate_Num,
       Well_Num      = i.Well_Num,
       Imagecopy_Num = i.Imagecopy_Num)]

# ── Un-parseable A-plate files (computed on the small unique table) ───────────
.unclean   <- is.na(u$plate_Num) | is.na(u$Well_Num) | is.na(u$Imagecopy_Num)
.is_Aplate <- (grepl("^A", u$plate_Num) %in% TRUE) | grepl("[-_]A\\d{4,}", u$PathName_DAPI)
unparsed_A_plates <- unique(u[.unclean & .is_Aplate,
                              .(FileName_DAPI, PathName_DAPI, plate_Num, Well_Num, Imagecopy_Num)])
cat("Un-parseable A-plate files:", nrow(unparsed_A_plates), "\n")

)

combined_data$plate_Num <- ifelse(combined_data$plate_Num %in% names(dp_map),
```

```{r}
# INDIVIDUAL CONDITION/CONTROL STATISTICS 
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#[OPTIONAL] Filter out bottom 75% (to control for a transfection efficiency of 1:4)
#Filter conditions that leave < 5 cells/image (too much variance for meaningful interpretation)

# ── DYNAMIC SCHEMA DETECTION (failsafe) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Harmonize the fast-loader output to the names the rest of this section expects,
# and flag which optional channels are present. Minimum assumed: nuclei + nuclear
# foci (the core readout). tdTomato, whole-cell (cytoplasmic) GFP, and cytoplasmic
# foci are OPTIONAL: if a channel is missing the analysis skips it and never errors.
combined_Df <- as.data.table(combined_Df)

# Rename `from` -> `to` only when `from` exists and `to` does not. This bridges the
# loader's output names to the legacy names used downstream (so older exports that
# already use the legacy names pass through untouched).
rename_if_present <- function(dt, from, to) {
  if (from %in% names(dt) && !(to %in% names(dt))) setnames(dt, from, to)
  invisible(dt)
}
rename_if_present(combined_Df, "NucFoci",                                 "Children_GFP_foci_Count")  # per-cell nuclear foci count
rename_if_present(combined_Df, "Nuc_Area",                                "AreaShape_Area")           # nucleus area
rename_if_present(combined_Df, "Nuc_FormFactor",                          "AreaShape_FormFactor")     # nucleus form factor
rename_if_present(combined_Df, "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_tdTomato",  "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_P2A_tdTomato")
rename_if_present(combined_Df, "AreaShape_Area_tdTomato",                  "AreaShape_Area_P2A_tdTomato")

# Presence flags: column exists AND has at least one non-NA value.
has_col <- function(dt, x) x %in% names(dt) && any(!is.na(dt[[x]]))
has_td_int        <- has_col(combined_Df, "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_P2A_tdTomato")
has_td_area       <- has_col(combined_Df, "AreaShape_Area_P2A_tdTomato")
has_cyto_gfp      <- has_col(combined_Df, "IntegratedIntensity_CytoplasmGFP")        # whole-cell GFP integrated intensity
has_cyto_foci     <- has_col(combined_Df, "CytoFoci")                                # cytoplasmic foci count
has_cyto_foci_int <- has_col(combined_Df, "Total_CytoFoci_IntegratedIntensity")
has_nucfoci_area  <- has_col(combined_Df, "Avg_NucFoci_Area")
has_nucfoci_compact    <- has_col(combined_Df, "Avg_NucFoci_Compactness")
has_nucfoci_int   <- has_col(combined_Df, "Avg_NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity")

# Hard requirement: nuclear-foci count is the core readout for everything below.
if (!("Children_GFP_foci_Count" %in% names(combined_Df)))
  stop("No nuclear-foci count column (NucFoci / Children_GFP_foci_Count) found -- this is the core readout.")

message("Channels detected -> tdTomato(int): ", has_td_int,
        " | whole-cell GFP: ", has_cyto_gfp,
        " | cyto foci: ", has_cyto_foci,
        " | nuc-foci morphology: ", has_nucfoci_area || has_nucfoci_compact || has_nucfoci_int)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

combined_Df <- combined_Df %>%

  group_by(plate_Num, Well_Num, ImageNumber) %>%
  
  arrange(Children_GFP_foci_Count, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  
  #---------------------------------------
  #COMMENT OUT UNLESS YOU WANT TO TAKE ONLY THE TOP 25% OF CELLS TO ACCOUNT FOR TRANSFECTION EFFICIENCY!!!
  # mutate(nlen = ceiling(n() * 0.75)) %>%
  # filter(row_number() > nlen) %>%
  #--------------------------------------

  filter(n() > 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  group_by(plate_Num, Well_Num, Imagecopy_Num) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Nuclei_Number = n(),
    mean_Nuc_Foci = mean(Children_GFP_foci_Count, na.rm = TRUE)
    
  ) %>%
  
  ungroup()

#Combine with assigned conditions:
dfSelection <- dfSelection %>% rename(Well_Num = Well)
combined_Df <- merge(combined_Df, dfSelection[, c('SignalStatus', 'Condition', 'Well_Num')], by = "Well_Num")

combined_Df <- combined_Df %>% 
  mutate(Condition = ifelse(Condition == "Test Condition", Well_Num, Condition)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(Condition))

#Calculate aggregate statistics for each condition:
combined_Df <- combined_Df %>%
  group_by(plate_Num, Well_Num) %>%
  
  # OPTIONAL [Filter out top image in case of screen aberration]
  #----------
  # mutate(
  #   n_images = n_distinct(ImageNumber),
  #   summary_condition = if_else(n_images >= 8 & mean_Nuc_Foci > 1, mean_Nuc_Foci < max(mean_Nuc_Foci), TRUE)
  # ) %>%
  #filter(summary_condition) %>%
  #----------

  summarise(
    Nuclei_Number = mean(Nuclei_Number, na.rm = TRUE),
    Nuclear_Area = mean(AreaShape_Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    FormFactor = mean(AreaShape_FormFactor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Foci      = mean(mean_Nuc_Foci, na.rm = TRUE),

    tdTomato_Area = if (has_td_area) mean(AreaShape_Area_P2A_tdTomato, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    tdTomato      = if (has_td_int)  mean(Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_P2A_tdTomato, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,

    # NEW per-condition metrics (materialized as NA when the channel is absent so
    # downstream select()/across()/diff calls never break) ----------------------
    WholeCell_GFP_IntegratedIntensity = if (has_cyto_gfp)      mean(IntegratedIntensity_CytoplasmGFP,   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,  # total cellular GFP integrated intensity / cell
    CytoFoci_Count        = if (has_cyto_foci)     mean(CytoFoci,                           na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,  # cytoplasmic foci count / cell
    NucFoci_Area          = if (has_nucfoci_area)  mean(Avg_NucFoci_Area,                   na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,  # nuclear-foci size
    NucFoci_Compactness    = if (has_nucfoci_compact)    mean(Avg_NucFoci_Compactness,             na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,  # nuclear-foci compactness
    NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity = if (has_nucfoci_int)   mean(Avg_NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity,    na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,  # nuclear-foci integrated intensity

    AssayType  = unique(SignalStatus),
    Condition  = unique(Condition),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Determine control statistics:
pos_Ctrl_DF <- combined_Df %>%
  group_by(plate_Num) %>%
  filter(Condition == pos_Ctrl) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_Pos_SD   = sd(Avg_Foci, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_Pos_Foci = mean(Avg_Foci, na.rm=TRUE),
    cv_Pos        = cv(Avg_Foci) * 100,

    tdTomato_Pos_Area      = if (has_td_area) mean(tdTomato_Area, na.rm=TRUE) else NA_real_,
    Nuclear_Pos_TdTomato   = if (has_td_int)  mean(tdTomato, na.rm=TRUE)      else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


neg_Ctrl_DF <- combined_Df %>%
  group_by(plate_Num) %>%
  filter(Condition == neg_Ctrl) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_Neg_SD   = sd(Avg_Foci, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Neg_Foci = mean(Avg_Foci, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_Neg        = cv(Avg_Foci) * 100,

    tdTomato_Neg_Area    = if (has_td_area) mean(tdTomato_Area, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    Nuclear_Neg_TdTomato = if (has_td_int)  mean(tdTomato, na.rm = TRUE)      else NA_real_,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

plate_Summary <- merge(pos_Ctrl_DF, neg_Ctrl_DF)

plate_Summary <- plate_Summary %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    ZPrime_Score = round(
      1 - (3 * (.data$mean_Pos_SD + .data$mean_Neg_SD) /
             abs(.data$mean_Pos_Foci - .data$mean_Neg_Foci)),
      2
    )
  )

SB_Plate <- plate_Summary %>% group_by(plate_Num) %>%
  mutate(
    SB_Plate = ifelse(
      unique(assayType) == "OFF", 
      mean_Neg_Foci / mean_Pos_Foci, 
      mean_Pos_Foci / mean_Neg_Foci
    )
  )


#EXPORT PLATE SUMMARY:
# plate_Summary$ZPrime_Score <- ZPrime_Score[[1]]
plate_Summary$SB_Plate <- SB_Plate$SB_Plate

p_ctrls <- combined_Df %>% filter( Condition == pos_Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(plate_Num) %>%
     summarise(Control = paste0(pos_Ctrl), across(c( Nuclei_Number, Avg_Foci, tdTomato), mean, na.rm = TRUE), Condition = pos_Ctrl)


n_ctrls <- combined_Df %>% filter( Condition == neg_Ctrl) %>% 
  group_by(plate_Num) %>%
     summarise(Control = paste0(neg_Ctrl), across(c(Nuclei_Number, Avg_Foci, tdTomato), mean, na.rm = TRUE), Condition = neg_Ctrl)

#Export controls summary:
ctrls <- rbind(p_ctrls, n_ctrls)

#Combined main dataframe: 
combined_Df <- merge(combined_Df, plate_Summary[, c("plate_Num", "ZPrime_Score")], by = "plate_Num" )
```

```{r}
# NORMALIZED EFFECTS & CYTOTOXICITY AND MORPHOLOGY ANALYSIS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#Creates a temp dataframe to not write over original
 temp_stats_Df<- combined_Df %>%
  # Remove controls
  filter(Condition == Well_Num) %>%
  
  # Group by plate number
  group_by(plate_Num) %>%
  
  # Calculate percent change relative to plate
  mutate(
    PercentEffect = ifelse(
      `AssayType` == "OFF",
      ((mean(Avg_Foci) - Avg_Foci) / mean(Avg_Foci)) * 100,
      ((Avg_Foci - mean(Avg_Foci)) / mean(Avg_Foci)) * 100
    ),
    
    # Calculate the mean and standard deviation of each plate (based on PercentEffect)
    mean_percentEffect = mean(PercentEffect),
    SD_percentEffect = sd(PercentEffect),
  
    # Calculate Z-scores for test conditions specific to each plate
    ZScore = (PercentEffect - mean_percentEffect) / SD_percentEffect,
  
    # Calculate normalized differences for nuclear area, form factor, and cell count
    NuclearAreaDiff = (Nuclear_Area - mean(Nuclear_Area)) / mean(Nuclear_Area) * 100,
    FormFactorDiff = (FormFactor - mean(FormFactor)) / mean(FormFactor) * 100,
    tdTomato_Diff = if (has_td_int) (tdTomato - mean(tdTomato)) / mean(tdTomato) * 100 else NA_real_,
    CellCountDiff = (Nuclei_Number - mean(Nuclei_Number)) / mean(Nuclei_Number) * 100,

    # NEW: per-condition CHANGE (% vs plate mean) in nuclear-foci morphology
    NucFoci_Area_Diff       = if (has_nucfoci_area) (NucFoci_Area       - mean(NucFoci_Area,       na.rm = TRUE)) / mean(NucFoci_Area,       na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else NA_real_,
    NucFoci_Compactness_Diff = if (has_nucfoci_compact)   (NucFoci_Compactness - mean(NucFoci_Compactness, na.rm = TRUE)) / mean(NucFoci_Compactness, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else NA_real_,
    NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity_Diff = if (has_nucfoci_int)  (NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity - mean(NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity, na.rm = TRUE)) / mean(NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else NA_real_
    )

# FAILSAFE: if tdTomato was absent, drop the all-NA diff column so the optional
# tdTomato residual analysis below (gated on column presence) is cleanly skipped.
if (!has_td_int) temp_stats_Df$tdTomato_Diff <- NULL

#Remove any duplicated columns up till now 

#OPTIONAL -- Can have a more detailed view on cytotoxicity based on cell count and nuclear health:
#Ceullular Health Function (as function of cell density, nuclear area, and nuclear formfactor/morphological differences)
temp_stats_Df <- temp_stats_Df %>%
  group_by(plate_Num, Well_Num) %>%
  mutate(Viability =
    CellCountDiff + ((100 + CellCountDiff) / 100) * ((NuclearAreaDiff + FormFactorDiff) / 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#Else:
# temp_stats_Df <- temp_stats_Df %>%
#   group_by(plate_Num, Well_Num) %>%
#   mutate(Viability =
#     CellCountDiff) %>%
#   ungroup()

temp_stats_Df %>% arrange(desc(NuclearAreaDiff))
```

```{r}
# B-SCORE CALCULATION (CONTROLS FOR POSITIONAL EFFECTS) 
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BScore_func <- function(df, rows, cols,
                        effect_col = "PercentEffect",
                        well_col   = "Well_Num") {

  temp_df <- df

  # Full plate indexing
  row_levels <- LETTERS[1:rows]
  col_levels <- 1:cols

  # Parse wells like A01, B12, etc.
  well <- as.character(temp_df[[well_col]])
  r <- substr(well, 1, 1)
  cnum <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^[A-Za-z]+", "", well)))

  keep <- !is.na(r) & !is.na(cnum) & r %in% row_levels & cnum %in% col_levels
  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(dplyr::tibble(Well_Num = character(0), BScore = numeric(0), BZ_Score = numeric(0)))
  }

  # Build full plate matrix
  mtx <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = rows, ncol = cols,
                dimnames = list(row_levels, as.character(col_levels)))

  eff <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(temp_df[[effect_col]]))

  # Fill matrix (vectorized)
  mtx[cbind(match(r[keep], row_levels), match(cnum[keep], col_levels))] <- eff[keep]

  # Median polish + MAD scaling (B-score)
  bmat <- tryCatch({
    mp <- stats::medpolish(mtx, trace.iter = FALSE)
    resid <- mp$residuals
    MAD <- stats::mad(resid, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(MAD) || MAD == 0) MAD <- 1
    resid / MAD
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Fallback: impute missing with plate median and retry
    fill <- stats::median(mtx, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(fill)) fill <- 0
    mtx[is.na(mtx)] <- fill

    mp <- stats::medpolish(mtx, trace.iter = FALSE)
    resid <- mp$residuals
    MAD <- stats::mad(resid, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(MAD) || MAD == 0) MAD <- 1
    resid / MAD
  })

  # Convert to tibble for wells present in this df
  out <- expand.grid(
    Row = row_levels,
    Col = col_levels,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out$Well_Num <- paste0(out$Row, sprintf("%02d", out$Col))
  out$BScore   <- as.vector(bmat)

  out <- dplyr::as_tibble(out) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Well_Num %in% unique(well[keep])) %>%
    dplyr::select(.data$Well_Num, .data$BScore)

  # BZ-score (within-plate normalization of B-score)
  mu <- mean(out$BScore, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv <- stats::sd(out$BScore, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) sdv <- 1

  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::mutate(BZ_Score = (.data$BScore - mu) / sdv)

  out
}

# ---- RUN B-SCORE ONLY WHEN:
# (1) assayType == "OFF" AND (2) plateSize >= 96
# Should not use BZ-Score if plate size is smaller than 96 wells
if (assayType == "OFF" && plateSize >= 96) {

bs_res <- temp_stats_Df %>%
  filter(Condition == Well_Num) %>%
  group_by(plate_Num) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(bscores = map(data, ~{
    out <- BScore_func(.x, rows = rows, cols = cols)
    out$plate_Num <- unique(.x$plate_Num)
    out
  })) %>%
  select(-data) %>%     # ← DROP IT HERE
  unnest(bscores)

  
  # Join back safely by plate + well (no row-order assumptions)
 temp_stats_Df <- temp_stats_Df %>%
  left_join(bs_res, by = c("plate_Num", "Well_Num")) %>%
  rename(BZScore = BZ_Score)

} else {
  # Explicitly create columns so downstream code doesn't break
  temp_stats_Df$BScore  <- NA_real_
  temp_stats_Df$BZScore <- NA_real_

  if (assayType == "OFF" && plateSize < 96) {
    message("Skipping B-score: plate size < 96 wells (medpolish is unstable with too few wells).")
  }
}
```

```{r}
                     "NucFoci_Area_Diff", "NucFoci_Compactness_Diff", "NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity_Diff",
                     "CytoFoci_Count")

if (assayType == "OFF") {
  keep_cols <- intersect(c(base_off, td_cols, new_metric_cols), names(combined_Df_out))

  combined_Df_out <- combined_Df_out %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    rename(
      Plate                = any_of("plate_Num"),
      Well                 = any_of("Well_Num"),
      PlateZPrimeScore     = any_of("ZPrime_Score"),
      PercentEffect        = any_of("PercentEffect"),
      AvgFoci              = any_of("Avg_Foci"),
      CellCountPercentDiff = any_of("CellCountDiff"),
      CellCount            = any_of("Nuclei_Number")
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(BZScore)) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

} else {
  keep_cols <- intersect(c(base_on, td_cols, new_metric_cols), names(combined_Df_out))

  combined_Df_out <- combined_Df_out %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    rename(
      Plate                = any_of("plate_Num"),
      Well                 = any_of("Well_Num"),
      PlateZPrimeScore     = any_of("ZPrime_Score"),
      PercentEffect        = any_of("PercentEffect"),
      AvgFoci              = any_of("Avg_Foci"),
      CellCountPercentDiff = any_of("CellCountDiff"),
      CellCount            = any_of("Nuclei_Number")
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(ZScore)) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}



#Reorder:
if (assayType == "OFF") {
combined_Df_out <- combined_Df_out %>% arrange(desc(BZScore))
 } else {
combined_Df_out <- combined_Df_out %>% arrange(desc(ZScore))
 }  

if (assayType == "OFF"){
  hits_df <- combined_Df_out %>% filter(BZScore >= 3)
} else {
  hits_df <- combined_Df_out %>% filter(ZScore >= 3)
}

    

# ---- DROP tdTomato columns if they are entirely NA ----
td_cols_all <- c(
  "tdTomato_Area", "tdTomato", "tdTomato_Diff",
  "TdTomato_Area", "TdTomatoIntensity",
  "Pos_TdTomatoArea", "Neg_TdTomatoArea",
  "Pos_TdTomatoIntensity", "Neg_TdTomatoIntensity", "residual"
)

combined_Df_out <- drop_all_na_cols(combined_Df_out, c(td_cols_all, new_metric_cols))
ctrls           <- drop_all_na_cols(ctrls, td_cols_all)
plate_Summary   <- drop_all_na_cols(plate_Summary, td_cols_all)

# ---- EXPORT ----
export_File <- file.path(file_Location, "CondenScreenV2.xlsx")
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Combined Analysis")
addWorksheet(wb, "Hits")
addWorksheet(wb, "Plate Statistics")
addWorksheet(wb, "Controls")

# IMPORTANT FIX: write combined_Df_out (not combined_Df)
writeData(wb, "Combined Analysis", combined_Df_out, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)

writeData(wb, sheet = "Hits", x = hits_df, startCol = 1,  startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)

writeData(wb, "Plate Statistics", plate_Summary, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
writeData(wb, "Controls", ctrls, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
 
freezePane(wb, sheet = "Combined Analysis", firstActiveRow = 2)
freezePane(wb, sheet = "Hits", firstActiveRow = 2)
freezePane(wb, "Plate Statistics", firstActiveRow = 2)
freezePane(wb, "Controls", firstActiveRow = 2)

saveWorkbook(wb, file = export_File, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ------------- SETUP AND CONFIGURATION -------------
# Disable scientific notation for better readability
options(scipen = 999)
# ============================================================================
# CONDENSCREEN FIGURE GENERATION 
# ============================================================================
 
# ------------- DATA LOADING AND PREPARATION -------------
# Load workbook from predefined location (assuming save_Location is defined elsewhere)
file_Location <- "/home/userX/pathsource/"
export_File <- paste0(file_Location, "CondenScreenV2_temp.xlsx" )  
save_Location <- file_Location
 image_Save_Location <- save_Location
wb <- loadWorkbook(export_File)
 
 
merged_df <- read.xlsx(wb, sheet = "Combined Analysis")
 
# Convert numeric columns to proper type
#merged_df <- merged_df[!as.character(merged_df$Plate) %in% c("45", "46", "47"), ]
#EDIT: Change to location of a file linking compound/gene names to each well, if applicable, else comment out, and run the following 
#############################################################
template_location <- file.path(file_Location, "plateMap.xlsx")
template_exists <- file.exists(template_location)
 
# Define candidates outside the if/else so both branches can access them
well_candidates   <- c("Well", "Well_Condition")
ref_candidates    <- c("Reference", "Gene", "Compound")
cas_candidates    <- c("CAS", "CAS.Number")
smiles_candidates <- c("SMILES")
 
if (template_exists) {
  template <- read.xlsx(template_location)
  
  pick_first_existing <- function(df, candidates) {
    intersect(candidates, colnames(df))[1]
  }
  
  well_col   <- pick_first_existing(template, well_candidates)
  ref_col    <- pick_first_existing(template, ref_candidates)
  cas_col    <- pick_first_existing(template, cas_candidates)
  smiles_col <- pick_first_existing(template, smiles_candidates)
  
  select_cols <- c(
    intersect("Plate", colnames(template)),
    well_col, ref_col, cas_col, smiles_col
  )
  select_cols <- select_cols[!is.na(select_cols)]
  
  template <- template %>%
    select(all_of(select_cols)) %>%
    rename(
      Well = any_of(well_candidates),
      CAS  = any_of(cas_candidates)
    )
  
  existing_ref <- intersect(ref_candidates, colnames(template))[1]
  if (!is.na(existing_ref)) {
    template <- template %>% rename(Reference = all_of(existing_ref))
  } else {
    template$Reference <- sprintf("%03d", seq_len(nrow(template)))
  }
  
  merged_df <- merged_df %>% select(-any_of(c("Reference", "Gene", "Compound", "SMILES")))
  merged_df <- merge(merged_df, template, by = c("Plate", "Well"))
  
} else {
  message("plateMap.xlsx not found at ", template_location, " — skipping template merge.")
  
  existing_ref <- intersect(ref_candidates, colnames(merged_df))[1]
  if (!is.na(existing_ref) && existing_ref != "Reference") {
    merged_df$Reference <- merged_df[[existing_ref]]
  } else if (is.na(existing_ref)) {
    merged_df$Reference <- sprintf("%03d", seq_len(nrow(merged_df)))
  }
}
sheet_hits = "Hits"
sheet_df = "Combined Analysis"
merged_df <- merged_df[!is.na(merged_df$Reference), ]  # Keep only rows with reference names (compounds, genes, etc.)
 
# 1) Build hits_df2 (hits + QC columns)
hits_df <- if (assayType == "OFF") {
  merged_df %>% filter(BZScore >= 3)
} else {
  merged_df %>% filter(ZScore >= 3)
}
 
# (optional) make factors safe for Excel
hits_df <- hits_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
merged_df2 <- merged_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
 
# 2) Load the existing workbook and overwrite both sheets
wb <- loadWorkbook(export_File)
 
if (sheet_hits %in% names(wb)) removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
addWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
#Order by BZ-Score (descending)
hits_df <- hits_df %>% arrange(desc(if ("BZScore" %in% names(.)) BZScore else ZScore))
 
writeData(wb, sheet_hits, hits_df, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
freezePane(wb, sheet_hits, firstActiveRow = 2)
addFilter(wb, sheet_hits, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(hits_df))
 
if (sheet_df %in% names(wb)) removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_df)
addWorksheet(wb, sheet_df)
 
#Order by BZ-Score (descending)
merged_df2 <- merged_df2 %>% arrange(desc(if ("BZScore" %in% names(.)) BZScore else ZScore))
writeData(wb, sheet_df, merged_df2, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
freezePane(wb, sheet_df, firstActiveRow = 2)
addFilter(wb, sheet_df, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(merged_df2))
 
saveWorkbook(wb, export_File, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
 #NORMALIZED SCORE PLOT:
 
# == tdTomato QUADRANT + RESIDUAL RESCUE (relocated here from mid-pipeline) =====
# Runs only when tdTomato data exist. Operates on the final reloaded `merged_df`
# (which carries PercentEffect, tdTomato_Diff, Plate, Well), saves the quadrant
# and residual-rescue figures next to the normalized-score plot, and adds:
#   - `residual`        : numeric, non-NA only for residual-rescued wells
#   - `residual_rescue` : TRUE/FALSE flag written to the Excel sheet
 
# Fallback for restarted sessions where `merged_df` was reloaded directly from
# CondenScreenV2.xlsx and the earlier `has_td_int <- has_col(...)` step never ran.
# Treat tdTomato as present if `tdTomato_Diff` exists in merged_df AND is actually
# populated (not all-NA, which is how the earlier pipeline marks "no tdTomato channel").
if (!exists("has_td_int")) {
  has_td_int <- "tdTomato_Diff" %in% names(merged_df) &&
    any(!is.na(merged_df$tdTomato_Diff))
}
 
if (has_td_int && "tdTomato_Diff" %in% names(merged_df)) {
 
  out_dir <- paste0(save_Location, "residuals/")
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
  # drop any stale residual columns so the joins below stay clean
  merged_df <- merged_df %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("residual", "residual_rescue")))
 
  # --- Classify wells ---
  # TotalPercentTdTomato: tdTomato signal expressed as % of the plate mean
  # (tdTomato_Diff is already the % difference from the plate mean, so 100 + diff).
  #
  # Hit-class boundary is driven by Z/BZ-score > 3 (not PercentEffect). A well
  # can be PercentEffect >= 40 and still be gray/red/yellow if its Z/BZ-score
  # doesn't clear 3 -- PercentEffect is shown on the y-axis but no longer used
  # for the color classification.
  score_col_hc <- if ("BZScore" %in% names(merged_df) && any(!is.na(merged_df$BZScore))) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
 
  tdTomato_Df <- merged_df %>%
    mutate(
      TotalPercentTdTomato = 100 + tdTomato_Diff,
      tdTomato_outlier = TotalPercentTdTomato > 150,
      score_value_hc = .data[[score_col_hc]],
 
      hit_class = case_when(
        # Viability is a % difference from the plate mean (centered at 0), so
        # "<= 50% viable" corresponds to a drop of more than 50 percentage
        # points relative to the plate mean, i.e. Viability < -50.
        Viability < -50 ~ "Low viability / toxic",
 
        tdTomato_outlier ~ "tdTomato outlier",
 
        score_value_hc > 3 & Viability >= -50 & TotalPercentTdTomato >= 75 ~
          "Confirmed hit",
 
        score_value_hc > 3 & Viability >= -50 & TotalPercentTdTomato < 75 ~
          "Suspect — co-suppressed",
 
        score_value_hc <= 3 & TotalPercentTdTomato < 75 ~
          "tdTomato suppressed only",
 
        TRUE ~ "Inactive"
      ),
 
      hit_class = factor(
        hit_class,
        levels = c(
          "Confirmed hit",
          "Low viability / toxic",
          "Suspect — co-suppressed",
          "tdTomato suppressed only",
          "Inactive",
          "tdTomato outlier"
        )
      )
    )
 
  # --- Colors ---
  hit_colors <- c(
    "Confirmed hit"            = "steelblue",
    "Low viability / toxic"    = "black",
    "Suspect — co-suppressed"  = "tomato",
    "tdTomato suppressed only" = "goldenrod",
    "Inactive"                 = "gray70",
    "tdTomato outlier"         = "darkgreen"
  )
 
  # --- Plot limits ---
  y_max <- max(tdTomato_Df$PercentEffect, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(tdTomato_Df$PercentEffect, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_min <- min(tdTomato_Df$TotalPercentTdTomato, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(tdTomato_Df$TotalPercentTdTomato, na.rm = TRUE)
 
  # --- Suspect wells for residual model ---
  suspects <- tdTomato_Df %>% filter(hit_class == "Suspect — co-suppressed")
 
  if (nrow(suspects) >= 3) {
 
    # --- Residual model ---
    suspect_model <- lm(PercentEffect ~ TotalPercentTdTomato, data = suspects)
    model_summary <- summary(suspect_model)
 
    suspects <- suspects %>%
      mutate(
        fitted        = fitted(suspect_model),
        residual      = residuals(suspect_model),
        residual_rank = rank(-residual),
        residual_hit  = residual >= 20 & Viability >= -50
      )
 
    # --- Save model summary ---
    sink(file.path(out_dir, "suspect_model_summary.txt"))
    cat("=== Suspect Cluster Regression Model ===\n\n")
    cat("Formula: PercentEffect ~ TotalPercentTdTomato\n")
    cat("Subset: hit_class == 'Suspect — co-suppressed'\n\n")
    print(model_summary)
    cat("\n=== Model Performance ===\n")
    cat("R-squared:         ", round(model_summary$r.squared,     3), "\n")
    cat("Adjusted R-squared:", round(model_summary$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")
    cat("Residual Std Error:", round(model_summary$sigma,         3), "\n")
    cat("\n=== Residual Rescue Rule ===\n")
    cat("Method: residual >= 20 AND Viability >= -50\n")
    cat("Rescued hits:", sum(suspects$residual_hit), "\n")
    cat("Total suspects:", nrow(suspects), "\n")
    sink()
 
    # --- Add residual-rescued flag back onto main plotting df ---
    rescued_ids <- suspects %>%
      filter(residual_hit) %>%
      select(Plate, Well)
 
    tdTomato_Df <- tdTomato_Df %>%
      left_join(
        rescued_ids %>% mutate(residual_rescued = TRUE),
        by = c("Plate", "Well")
      ) %>%
      mutate(residual_rescued = ifelse(is.na(residual_rescued), FALSE, residual_rescued))
 
  } else {
 
    suspects <- suspects %>%
      mutate(
        fitted        = NA_real_,
        residual      = NA_real_,
        residual_rank = NA_real_,
        residual_hit  = FALSE
      )
 
    tdTomato_Df <- tdTomato_Df %>% mutate(residual_rescued = FALSE)
 
    message("Too few suspects (", nrow(suspects), ") for residual model -- skipping residual rescue.")
  }
 
  # --- hit_class_final: folds in residual-rescue + low-viability override ---
  # (computed once, regardless of which branch above ran, so p1 only needs
  # to be built a single time below)
  tdTomato_Df <- tdTomato_Df %>%
    mutate(
      hit_class_final = case_when(
        Viability < -50 ~ "Low viability / toxic",
        residual_rescued & Viability >= -50 ~ "Residual-rescued",
        TRUE ~ as.character(hit_class)
      ),
      hit_class_final = factor(
        hit_class_final,
        levels = c(
          "Confirmed hit",
          "Residual-rescued",
          "Low viability / toxic",
          "Suspect — co-suppressed",
          "tdTomato suppressed only",
          "Inactive",
          "tdTomato outlier"
        )
      )
    )
 
  hit_colors_final <- c(
    "Confirmed hit"            = "steelblue",
    "Residual-rescued"         = "steelblue",
    "Low viability / toxic"    = "black",
    "Suspect — co-suppressed"  = "tomato",
    "tdTomato suppressed only" = "goldenrod",
    "Inactive"                 = "gray70",
    "tdTomato outlier"         = "darkgreen"
  )
 
  # --- P1: quadrant plot (built once; viable residual-rescued labeled in blue) ---
  p1 <- ggplot(
    tdTomato_Df,
    aes(x = TotalPercentTdTomato, y = PercentEffect, color = hit_class_final)
  ) +
    # --- Points, layered so gray "Inactive" wells fade into the background ---
    # --- and the blue confirmed/rescued hits stand out clearly.            ---
    geom_point(
      data = tdTomato_Df %>% filter(hit_class_final == "Inactive"),
      alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = tdTomato_Df %>% filter(!hit_class_final %in% c("Inactive", "Confirmed hit", "Residual-rescued")),
      alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = tdTomato_Df %>% filter(hit_class_final %in% c("Confirmed hit", "Residual-rescued")),
      alpha = 0.9, size = 2.2
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = tdTomato_Df %>%
        filter(hit_class_final %in% c("Confirmed hit", "Residual-rescued"), PercentEffect > 33.3),
      aes(label = Reference),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Also label any well with a strong effect (>75%) that isn't tdTomato-suppressed
    # (red "Suspect" or yellow "tdTomato suppressed only"), even if it didn't clear
    # the tdTomato/viability bars for "Confirmed hit"
    geom_text_repel(
      
      data = tdTomato_Df %>%
        filter(PercentEffect > 75,
           !hit_class_final %in% c("Suspect — co-suppressed", "tdTomato suppressed only", "Low viability / toxic")),
      
       
      aes(label = Reference),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = hit_colors_final) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(max(0, x_min), min(150, x_max)),
      ylim = c(y_min, y_max)
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 33.3, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    annotate(
      "text", x = 76, y = y_max * 0.95,
      label = "Confirmed / residual-rescued", color = "steelblue", size = 3, hjust = 0
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = max(1, x_min), y = y_max * 0.95,
      label = "Suspect / co-suppressed", color = "tomato", size = 3, hjust = 0
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "tdTomato % of plate mean",
      y = "MLF2-GFP % Effect",
      color = "Hit class",
      title = "Quadrant: PercentEffect vs. tdTomato",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Blue = viable confirmed/residual-rescued hits (", score_col_hc, " > 3, tdTomato >= 75% or residual-rescued, Viability >= -50); ",
        "black = Viability < -50. PercentEffect (y-axis) does not affect color."
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
 
  if (nrow(suspects) >= 3) {
 
    # --- P2: residual rescue plot ---
    p2 <- ggplot(suspects, aes(x = TotalPercentTdTomato, y = PercentEffect)) +
      geom_segment(
        aes(xend = TotalPercentTdTomato, yend = fitted),
        color = "gray60", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      geom_point(aes(color = residual_hit), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = suspects %>% filter(residual_hit),
        aes(label = Reference),
        size = 3,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        box.padding = 0.3,
        point.padding = 0.25,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "gray30", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "tomato", "TRUE" = "steelblue"),
                         labels = c("FALSE" = "Suspect", "TRUE" = "Residual-rescued")) +
      labs(
        x        = "tdTomato % of plate mean",
        y        = "MLF2-GFP % Effect",
        color    = NULL,
        title    = "Residual rescue within viable suspect cluster",
        subtitle = paste0("R² = ",    round(model_summary$r.squared, 2),
                          "  |  Adj R² = ", round(model_summary$adj.r.squared, 2),
                          "  |  slope = ", round(coef(suspect_model)[2], 2),
                          "  |  n = ",    nrow(suspects),
                          "  |  rescue rule: residual >= 20 and Viability >= -50")
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
 
    combined <- p1 / p2
    # print() can occasionally exceed the RStudio Plots pane's minimum size and
    # throw "Plots window too small"; that's a display-only issue, the figures
    # are still written to disk below, so don't let it abort the chunk.
    tryCatch(print(combined), error = function(e) {
      message("Skipping inline preview of combined plot (display area too small): ", conditionMessage(e))
    })
 
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "p1_percenteffect_quadrant.png"), p1, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "p2_residual_rescue.png"), p2,       width = 10, height = 7,  dpi = 300)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "residual_plots.png"),     combined, width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(image_Save_Location, "tdTomato_quadrant.pdf"), p1, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(image_Save_Location, "tdTomato_residual_rescue.pdf"), p2, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
 
    # --- bring `residual` back onto merged_df for viable RESCUED wells only ---
    merged_df <- merged_df %>%
      left_join(suspects %>% filter(residual_hit) %>% select(Plate, Well, residual),
                by = c("Plate", "Well"))
 
  } else {
 
    tryCatch(print(p1), error = function(e) {
      message("Skipping inline preview of p1 (display area too small): ", conditionMessage(e))
    })
 
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "p1_percenteffect_quadrant.png"), p1, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(image_Save_Location, "tdTomato_quadrant.pdf"), p1, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
 
    merged_df$residual <- NA_real_
  }
 
  # residual_rescue flag for the Excel sheet (TRUE only for viable residual-rescued wells)
  merged_df <- merged_df %>% mutate(residual_rescue = !is.na(residual))
 
  # --- Aux workbook ---
  wb_res <- createWorkbook()
 
  addWorksheet(wb_res, "All Wells")
  writeData(wb_res, "All Wells", tdTomato_Df %>% arrange(desc(PercentEffect)))
 
  addWorksheet(wb_res, "Confirmed Hits")
  writeData(wb_res, "Confirmed Hits",
            tdTomato_Df %>%
              filter(hit_class_final %in% c("Confirmed hit", "Residual-rescued")) %>%
              filter(Viability >= -50) %>%
              arrange(desc(PercentEffect)))
 
  addWorksheet(wb_res, "Residual Rescued")
  writeData(wb_res, "Residual Rescued",
            suspects %>% filter(residual_hit, Viability >= -50) %>% arrange(desc(residual)))
 
  addWorksheet(wb_res, "Suspects")
  writeData(wb_res, "Suspects", suspects %>% arrange(desc(residual)))
 
  addWorksheet(wb_res, "Export Hits")
  writeData(wb_res, "Export Hits",
            tdTomato_Df %>%
              filter(hit_class_final %in% c("Confirmed hit", "Residual-rescued")) %>%
              filter(Viability >= -50) %>%
              arrange(desc(PercentEffect)))
 
  addWorksheet(wb_res, "Low Viability Toxic")
  writeData(wb_res, "Low Viability Toxic",
            tdTomato_Df %>% filter(Viability < -50) %>% arrange(desc(PercentEffect)))
 
  saveWorkbook(wb_res, file.path(out_dir, "residual_analysis.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
 
  cat("tdTomato quadrant/residual analysis complete. Aux outputs in:", out_dir, "\n")
 
  # --- Re-write Combined Analysis + Hits with residual + residual_rescue ---
  if (exists("export_File") && file.exists(export_File)) {
    wb_x <- loadWorkbook(export_File)
    md_x <- merged_df %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
      arrange(desc(if ("BZScore" %in% names(.)) BZScore else ZScore))
    hd_x <- if (assayType == "OFF") filter(md_x, BZScore >= 3) else filter(md_x, ZScore >= 3)
    for (s in c("Combined Analysis", "Hits")) if (s %in% names(wb_x)) removeWorksheet(wb_x, s)
    addWorksheet(wb_x, "Combined Analysis"); writeData(wb_x, "Combined Analysis", md_x)
    freezePane(wb_x, "Combined Analysis", firstActiveRow = 2)
    addFilter(wb_x, "Combined Analysis", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(md_x))
    addWorksheet(wb_x, "Hits"); writeData(wb_x, "Hits", hd_x)
    freezePane(wb_x, "Hits", firstActiveRow = 2)
    addFilter(wb_x, "Hits", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(hd_x))
    saveWorkbook(wb_x, export_File, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
}
 
score_col <- if ("BZScore" %in% names(merged_df)) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
 
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    score_value = .data[[score_col]],
    bz_hit  = score_value >= 3,
    td_ok   = if (has_td_int && "tdTomato_Diff" %in% names(.)) {
                # passes if tdTomato drop is acceptable OR was flagged by residual method.
                # `residual` only exists when the residual-rescue step produced hits, so
                # guard on its presence (otherwise it's all-NA and gets dropped on export).
                if ("residual" %in% names(.)) {
                  (tdTomato_Diff >= -25) | (!is.na(residual))
                } else {
                  tdTomato_Diff >= -25
                }
              } else {
                TRUE  # no tdTomato data or not applicable — don't penalize
              },
    viab_ok = if ("Viability" %in% names(.))
                Viability >= -25
              else TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(-score_value)
 
# --- Export Hits sheet: BZ/Z >= 3 AND passes viability AND (tdTomato OK or residual-rescued) ---
if (exists("export_File") && file.exists(export_File)) {
  export_hits_df <- merged_df %>%
    filter(bz_hit, viab_ok, td_ok) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[score_col]]))
 
  wb_eh <- loadWorkbook(export_File)
  if ("Export Hits" %in% names(wb_eh)) removeWorksheet(wb_eh, "Export Hits")
  addWorksheet(wb_eh, "Export Hits")
  writeData(wb_eh, "Export Hits", export_hits_df, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb_eh, "Export Hits", firstActiveRow = 2)
  addFilter(wb_eh, "Export Hits", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(export_hits_df))
  saveWorkbook(wb_eh, export_File, overwrite = TRUE)
 
  cat("Export Hits sheet written:", nrow(export_hits_df), "hits passing BZ/Z >= 3, viability, and tdTomato/residual-rescue criteria\n")
}
 
 plot_normalized_score <- function(df, assay_type, image_path, has_td_int = TRUE) {
  score_col <- if (assay_type == "OFF") "BZScore" else "ZScore"   # keep as string; symbol can't index df[[ ]]
  label_y   <- if (assay_type == "OFF") "BZ-Score" else "Z-Score"
  y_limits  <- c(min(merged_df[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE), max(merged_df[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE))
  y_breaks  <- c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8)
 
  hits_df <- dplyr::filter(df, .data[[score_col]] >= 3)
  bg_df   <- dplyr::filter(df, .data[[score_col]] < 3)
 
  if (has_td_int) {
    hits_df <- hits_df %>% mutate(pass = as.character(td_ok & viab_ok))
  } else {
    # No tdTomato channel: td_ok defaults to TRUE (set above), but viability
    # still matters, so a hit only passes if it clears the viability bar.
    hits_df <- hits_df %>% mutate(pass = as.character(viab_ok))
  }
 
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = paste0(Well, Plate), y = .data[[score_col]])) +
    geom_point(
      data     = bg_df,
      color    = "gray70",
      size     = 0.5,
      alpha    = 0.3,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data  = hits_df,
      aes(color = pass, size = pass),
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    # Only label the strongest red hits (BZ/Z > 4) to avoid an unreadable wall of text
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    scale_size_manual(values  = c("TRUE" = 1.6,   "FALSE" = 1.2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.5) +
   
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, breaks = y_breaks) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Compound", y = label_y) +
    guides(color = "none", size = "none")
 
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(image_path, "normalized_SigScoreTdTomatoScreen.pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    dpi      = 300,
    width    = 8,
    height   = 8
  )
 
  return(p)
}
plot_normalized_score(merged_df, assayType, image_Save_Location, has_td_int = has_td_int)
```

```{r}
###OPTIONAL###
 
# ============================================================
# HTS Spatial QC - Global Row/Col MEDIAN shifts + Heatmaps
# Refactored for improved readability and logical flow
# ============================================================
 
# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
#If not previously defined:
#fileX   <- "/home/userX/pathsource/CondenScreenV2.xlsx"
 
file_Location    <- "/nfs/roberts/scratch/pi_cs723/djp94/YCMD/UseChemicalDiversityAll/"
fileX            <- paste0(file_Location, "CondenScreenV2.xlsx")
sheetX           <- "Combined Analysis"
out_dir          <- paste0(file_Location, "HTS_QC_OUT/")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
#Update this value based on the Z-Score or BZ-Score threshold you are using for hit selection. 
#If hit_threshold <- 2, then any well positions that are called as hits if Z or BZ-Score >= 2. 
hit_threshold <- 2
#QC threshold to identify significant row/col shifts in hit frequency (chi-square test) or score distribution.
alpha_qc <- 0.05
well_fold_threshold <- 3   # flag well positions hit >= Nx the mean recurrence rate
score_outlier_sd <- 3      # flag cols/rows whose median BZScore is >n SDs from mean of medians
 
# ============================================================
# 2. HELPERS
# ============================================================
save_plot <- function(p, fname, w=12, h=6)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, fname), plot=p, width=w, height=h, dpi=300)
 
theme_prismish <- function(base_size=12)
  theme_classic(base_size=base_size) +
  theme(plot.title   = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(face="bold", size=14),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(face="bold", size=14),
        panel.grid   = element_blank())
 
bar_shift <- function(df_sum, xcol, ycol, title, xlab, ylab, rotate_x=FALSE, ylim=NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(df_sum, aes(x=.data[[xcol]], y=.data[[ycol]])) +
    geom_col(fill="#2E1A47", color="black", linewidth=0.25, width=0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.4) +
    labs(title=title, x=xlab, y=ylab) + theme_prismish()
  if (!is.null(ylim))  p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim=ylim)
  if (rotate_x)        p <- p + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, hjust=1))
  p
}
 
heatmap_metric <- function(df_grid, fill_col, title, fill_lab)
  ggplot(df_grid, aes(x=factor(col2), y=row, fill=.data[[fill_col]])) +
  geom_tile(color=NA) +
  labs(title=title, x="Column", y="Row", fill=fill_lab) +
  theme_prismish() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5), legend.position="right") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option="viridis", na.value="grey90") +
  guides(fill=guide_colorbar(title.position="top", barwidth=unit(0.5,"cm"), barheight=unit(6,"cm")))
 
parse_well <- function(df)
  df %>% mutate(row=str_sub(Well,1,1), col=as.integer(str_remove(Well,"^[A-Za-z]")),
                col2=sprintf("%02d",col), well_pos=paste0(row,col2))
 
chisq_hit_test <- function(df, group_var, hit_col="Hit") {
  counts <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarize(n=n(), hits=sum(.data[[hit_col]]==1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(hit_rate=hits/n)
  ct <- chisq.test(counts$hits, p=counts$n/sum(counts$n))
  counts %>% mutate(std_resid=as.numeric(ct$stdres), global_p=ct$p.value,
                    flagged=global_p < alpha_qc & abs(std_resid) > 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(std_resid)))
}
 
chisq_score_shift <- function(df, group_var, score_col=NULL, n_sd=score_outlier_sd) {
  if (is.null(score_col)) stop("score_col must be specified, e.g. 'BZScore' or 'ZScore'")
  grp_medians <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarize(n=n(), med=median(.data[[score_col]], na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
  global_mean <- mean(grp_medians$med, na.rm=TRUE)
  global_sd   <- sd(grp_medians$med,   na.rm=TRUE)
  grp_medians %>%
    mutate(
      z_of_median = (med - global_mean) / global_sd,
      flagged     = abs(z_of_median) > n_sd,
      direction   = case_when(
        z_of_median >  n_sd ~ "enriched",
        z_of_median < -n_sd ~ "suppressed",
        TRUE                ~ "normal"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(z_of_median)))
}
 
# Fold-over-mean recurrence  
well_recurrence_test <- function(df, hit_col="Hit", fold_threshold=well_fold_threshold) {
  n_pl <- n_distinct(df$Plate)
  recurrence <- df %>% filter(.data[[hit_col]]==1) %>%
    group_by(well_pos) %>%
    summarize(n_plates_as_hit=n_distinct(Plate), hit_rate=n_plates_as_hit/n_pl,
              plates=paste(sort(unique(Plate)), collapse=", "), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_plates_as_hit))
  mean_recurrence <- mean(recurrence$n_plates_as_hit)
  threshold       <- mean_recurrence * fold_threshold
  cat("Well recurrence: mean =", round(mean_recurrence,2),
      "| fold threshold =", fold_threshold,
      "| flagging wells with >=", round(threshold,2), "plates\n")
  recurrence %>% mutate(
    mean_recurrence = mean_recurrence,
    fold_over_mean  = n_plates_as_hit / mean_recurrence,
    flagged         = n_plates_as_hit >= threshold
  )
}
 
plot_plate_hits <- function(df, hit_col="Hit", sig_plates=character(0), title="Hits: global plate totals") {
  plate_sum <- df %>% group_by(Plate) %>%
    summarize(hit_sum=sum(.data[[hit_col]]==1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(sig=Plate %in% sig_plates)
  
  ggplot(plate_sum, aes(x=factor(Plate), y=hit_sum)) +
    geom_col(fill="#2E1A47", color="black", linewidth=0.25, width=0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label=hit_sum), vjust=-0.35, size=3) +
    geom_text(data=subset(plate_sum,sig), aes(label="*"), vjust=-1.2, size=6) +
    labs(title=title, x="Plate", y="Total hits") + theme_prismish() +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, hjust=1))
}
 
paper_div_impact_clean <- function(lims=c(-2,2), midpoint=0)
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours=c("#E00000","#FF7A00","#FFFFFF","#5A0AA4","#1A0033"),
    values=scales::rescale(c(lims[1], lims[1]+(midpoint-lims[1])*0.5, midpoint,
                             midpoint+(lims[2]-midpoint)*0.5, lims[2]), from=lims),
    limits=lims, oob=scales::squish)
 
hit_impact_purple_deeper <- function(max_hits, zero_color="#F5F5F5")
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours=c(zero_color,"#B8AEC9","#5A3E86","#4A3A73","#1A0033"),
    values=scales::rescale(c(0, max_hits*0.3, max_hits*0.55, max_hits*0.8, max_hits),
                           from=c(0,max_hits)),
    limits=c(0,max_hits), oob=scales::squish,
    guide=guide_colorbar(title="Hits per well", barheight=unit(5,"cm")))
 
heatmap_theme_clean <- theme(
  plot.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust=0),
  axis.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
  axis.text.x=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  axis.text.y=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  legend.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
  legend.text=element_text(size=12, face="bold"))
 
# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD & PREP
# ============================================================
df <- read.xlsx(fileX, sheet=sheetX) %>% parse_well()
if (!("BZScore" %in% colnames(df))) df$BZScore <- NA_real_
has_bz <- any(!is.na(df$BZScore))
 
df <- df %>% mutate(
  Hit  = if ("Hit" %in% colnames(.)) as.integer(Hit)
         else if (has_bz) as.integer(BZScore >= hit_threshold)
         else as.integer(ZScore >= hit_threshold),
  row      = factor(str_sub(Well,1,1) %>% {factor(., levels=sort(unique(.)))}),
  col2     = factor(sprintf("%02d", as.integer(str_remove(Well,"^[A-Za-z]"))),
                    levels=sprintf("%02d", sort(unique(as.integer(str_remove(Well,"^[A-Za-z]")))))),
  well_pos = factor(well_pos)
)
 
score_metric <- if ("Hit" %in% colnames(df)) "Hit (precomputed)" else if (has_bz) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
score_col    <- if (has_bz) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
 
# ============================================================
# 4. SUMMARIES
# ============================================================
summarize_by <- function(df, grp, ...) df %>% group_by(.data[[grp]]) %>% summarize(..., .groups="drop")
 
row_z  <- summarize_by(df,"row",  med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
row_bz <- summarize_by(df,"row",  med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
row_h  <- summarize_by(df,"row",  hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE))
col_z  <- summarize_by(df,"col2", med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
col_bz <- summarize_by(df,"col2", med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
col_h  <- summarize_by(df,"col2", hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE))
 
grid_sum <- df %>% group_by(row,col2) %>%
  summarize(med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE), med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE),
            hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
 
plate_row_stats <- df %>% group_by(Plate,row) %>%
  summarize(n=n(), med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE), med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE),
            hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
plate_col_stats <- df %>% group_by(Plate,col2) %>%
  summarize(n=n(), med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE), med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE),
            hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
 
# ============================================================
# 5. TESTS
# ============================================================
test_row_hit         <- chisq_hit_test(df,"row")
test_col_hit         <- chisq_hit_test(df,"col2")
test_plate_hit       <- chisq_hit_test(df, "Plate")
 
test_well_recurrence <- well_recurrence_test(df, fold_threshold=well_fold_threshold)
test_col_score_shift <- chisq_score_shift(df, "col2", score_col=score_col)
test_row_score_shift <- chisq_score_shift(df, "row",  score_col=score_col)
 
sig_rows_hit     <- test_row_hit         %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(row)      %>% as.character()
sig_cols_hit     <- test_col_hit         %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(col2)     %>% as.character()
sig_plates_hit   <- test_plate_hit %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(Plate) %>% as.character()
recurrent_wells  <- test_well_recurrence %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(well_pos) %>% as.character()
sig_cols_score   <- test_col_score_shift %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(col2)     %>% as.character()
sig_rows_score   <- test_row_score_shift %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(row)      %>% as.character()
 
col_direction <- test_col_score_shift %>% filter(flagged) %>% select(col2, direction) %>% deframe()
row_direction <- test_row_score_shift %>% filter(flagged) %>% select(row,  direction) %>% deframe()
 
cat("Flagged rows:", length(sig_rows_hit), "| cols:", length(sig_cols_hit),
    "| score-outlier rows:", length(sig_rows_score), "| score-outlier cols:", length(sig_cols_score),
    "| wells:", length(recurrent_wells), "| plates:", length(sig_plates_hit), "\n")
# ============================================================
# 6. PLOTS
# ============================================================
lim_val  <- function(x) { v <- max(abs(x), na.rm=TRUE); ifelse(is.finite(v) && v>0, v, 1) }

type_string <- function(pl, r, c, wp) {
  out <- character(0)
  if (!is.na(r)  && as.character(r)  %in% sig_rows_hit)
    out <- c(out, "Row enrichment [Chi-sq]")
  if (!is.na(r)  && as.character(r)  %in% sig_rows_score)
    out <- c(out, paste0("Row score ", row_direction[as.character(r)], " [BZScore outlier]"))
  if (!is.na(c)  && as.character(c)  %in% sig_cols_hit)
    out <- c(out, "Col enrichment [Chi-sq]")
  if (!is.na(c)  && as.character(c)  %in% sig_cols_score)
    out <- c(out, paste0("Col score ", col_direction[as.character(c)], " [BZScore outlier]"))
  if (!is.na(wp) && as.character(wp) %in% recurrent_wells)
    out <- c(out, paste0("Well recurrence [>=", well_fold_threshold, "x mean]"))
  if (!is.na(pl) && as.character(pl) %in% sig_plates_hit)
    out <- c(out, "Plate enrichment [Hit]")
  if (length(out)==0) return("None")
  paste(unique(out), collapse="; ")
}
```

```{r}
cache_get <- function(key) {
  if (exists(key, envir = smiles_cache, inherits = FALSE)) 
    get(key, envir = smiles_cache) 
  else NULL
}
 
cache_set <- function(key, value) assign(key, value, envir = smiles_cache)
 
cache_flush <- function() {
  keys <- ls(smiles_cache, all.names = TRUE)
  if (length(keys) > 0) {
    tibble::tibble(
      key = keys,
      value = vapply(keys, function(k) get(k, envir = smiles_cache), character(1))
    ) %>% readr::write_tsv(CACHE_PATH)
  }
}

# ============================================================
# 3) Identifier cleaning and SMILES retrieval
# ============================================================
 
#clean_cas -- experimental: Will try to increase the chance PubChem/CACTUS recognizes your CAS. May need adjustment on case-by-case basis
clean_cas <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(x))) return(NA_character_)
  x <- trimws(gsub("\\[.*?\\]", "", as.character(x)))
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, "[,;]")))
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
  if (length(parts) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  is_cas <- grepl("^\\d{2,7}-\\d{2}-\\d$", parts)
  if (any(is_cas)) parts[which(is_cas)[1]] else parts[1]
}
 
 
#clean SMILES:
normalize_key <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[\t\r\n]", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  tolower(x)
}
 
sanitize_smiles <- function(smi) {
  if (is.na(smi) || !nzchar(trimws(smi))) return(NA_character_)
  smi <- trimws(smi)
  smi <- gsub("[\t\r\n ]+", "", smi)
  smi <- gsub("\\|", ".", smi)
  smi
}
 
#Try parse SMILES into an RDKit molecule, else NULL
safe_mol <- function(smi) {
  if (is.na(smi) || !nzchar(trimws(smi))) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(Chem$MolFromSmiles(trimws(smi)), error = function(e) NULL)
}
 
is_valid_smiles <- function(smi) {
  mol <- safe_mol(smi)
  !is.null(mol)
}
 
 
 
#Returning SMILES:
#--------
#Will try to parse PubChem first for SMILES...
pubchem_smiles <- function(id, namespace = c("name", "rn"), timeout_s = 20) {
  namespace <- match.arg(namespace)
  if (is.na(id) || !nzchar(trimws(id))) return(NA_character_)
  
  url <- sprintf(
    "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/%s/%s/property/IsomericSMILES,CanonicalSMILES/JSON",
    namespace, URLencode(id, reserved = TRUE)
  )
  
  resp <- tryCatch(request(url) |> req_timeout(timeout_s) |> req_perform(), 
                   error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(resp) || resp_status(resp) >= 400) return(NA_character_)
  
  j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(resp_body_string(resp)), error = function(e) NULL)
  props <- j$PropertyTable$Properties
  if (is.null(props) || nrow(props) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  smi <- props$IsomericSMILES[1]
  if (is.null(smi) || is.na(smi) || !nzchar(smi)) smi <- props$CanonicalSMILES[1]
  if (is.null(smi) || is.na(smi) || !nzchar(smi)) NA_character_ else smi
}
 
 
#... but if fails will resort to CACTUS, NCI Chemical Identifier Resolver: https://cactus.nci.nih.gov/chemical/structure
cactus_smiles <- function(id, timeout_s = 20) {
  if (is.na(id) || !nzchar(trimws(id))) return(NA_character_)
 
  url <- sprintf("https://cactus.nci.nih.gov/chemical/structure/%s/smiles",
                 URLencode(id, reserved = TRUE))
 
  for (k in 1:3) {
    resp <- tryCatch(request(url) |> req_timeout(timeout_s) |> req_perform(),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(resp) && resp_status(resp) < 400) {
      smi <- sanitize_smiles(resp_body_string(resp))
      if (!is.na(smi) && !grepl("not found", smi, ignore.case = TRUE) && is_valid_smiles(smi)) {
        return(smi)
      }
    }
    Sys.sleep(0.5 * k)
  }
  NA_character_
}
 
get_smiles <- function(cas, name) {
  cas1  <- clean_cas(cas)
  name1 <- if (is.na(name) || !nzchar(trimws(name))) NA_character_ else trimws(name)
 
  # normalized cache keys
  key_rn <- if (!is.na(cas1)) paste0("RN:", normalize_key(cas1)) else NULL
  key_nm <- if (!is.na(name1)) paste0("NM:", normalize_key(name1)) else NULL
 
  # ---- cache check (use normalized keys only)
  for (key in c(key_rn, key_nm)) {
    if (!is.null(key)) {
      cached <- cache_get(key)
      if (!is.null(cached) && !identical(cached, "NA") && nzchar(cached)) {
        # sanitize/validate cached (in case old bad entries exist)
        cached2 <- sanitize_smiles(cached)
        if (!is.na(cached2) && is_valid_smiles(cached2)) return(cached2)
      }
      if (!is.null(cached) && identical(cached, "NA")) return(NA_character_)
    }
  }
 
  # ---- retrieval
  smi <- NA_character_
  if (!is.na(cas1)) smi <- pubchem_smiles(cas1, "rn")
  if (is.na(smi) && !is.na(name1)) smi <- pubchem_smiles(name1, "name")
  if (is.na(smi) && !is.na(cas1)) smi <- cactus_smiles(cas1)
  if (is.na(smi) && !is.na(name1)) smi <- cactus_smiles(name1)
 
  # ---- sanitize + validate
  smi <- sanitize_smiles(smi)
  if (!is.na(smi) && !is_valid_smiles(smi)) smi <- NA_character_
 
  # ---- cache (normalized keys only)
  if (!is.null(key_rn)) cache_set(key_rn, ifelse(is.na(smi), "NA", smi))
  if (!is.null(key_nm)) cache_set(key_nm, ifelse(is.na(smi), "NA", smi))
 
  smi
}

# ============================================================
# 4) RDKit setup and molecular processing
# ============================================================
 
#Import modules for describing molecular descriptors (e.g., molc. weight), cLogP, Lipinski counts, and safeguard measures.
Desc <- import("rdkit.Chem.Descriptors")
Crip <- import("rdkit.Chem.Crippen")
Lip <- import("rdkit.Chem.Lipinski")
rdMS <- import("rdkit.Chem.MolStandardize.rdMolStandardize")
uncharger <- rdMS$Uncharger()
largest_frag <- rdMS$LargestFragmentChooser()
 
 
 
#Try to edit SMILES format to reflect canonical SMILES [avoids salt charges, keeps largest fragment, etc.]
canonicalize_parent <- function(smiles) {
  if (is.na(smiles) || !nzchar(trimws(smiles))) return(NA_character_)
  
  mol <- safe_mol(smiles)
  if (is.null(mol)) return(NA_character_)
  
  mol <- tryCatch(uncharger$uncharge(mol), error = function(e) mol)
  mol <- tryCatch(largest_frag$choose(mol), error = function(e) mol)
  
  tryCatch(Chem$MolToSmiles(mol, canonical = TRUE, kekuleSmiles = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NA_character_)
}
```
