```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5) Load structural alerts
# ============================================================
 
#All credit for the initial chemical alerts goes to Pat Walters.
#See Pat Walter's GitHub, rd_fitlers, for more information: https://github.com/PatWalters/rd_filters.git
#The csv file can alternatively be downloaded directly with the rest of the CondenScreen code in https://github.com/SchliekerLab/Condenscreen-v1.1.git
 
 
 
 
get_alerts <- function(cache_dir = "nuisance_cache",
                       local_file = "alert_collection_PatWalters.csv") {
  dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  f_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "alert_collection.csv")
  url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PatWalters/rd_filters/master/rd_filters/data/alert_collection.csv"
 
  # ---- Prefer local file, then cached file, else download ----
  if (file.exists(local_file)) {
    message("Using local alert file: ", local_file)
    al <- read.csv(local_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (file.exists(f_cache)) {
    message("Using cached alert file: ", f_cache)
    al <- read.csv(f_cache, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    message("Downloading alert collection from GitHub...")
    download.file(url, f_cache, mode = "wb")
    al <- read.csv(f_cache, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
 
  # ---- Detect column names (robust to schema changes) ----
  nms <- names(al)
 
  smarts_col <- nms[grep("smarts", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # rule_set numeric (e.g., 2,3,4...) if present
  rule_set_col <- nms[grep("^rule.?set$|rule_set", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # rule_set_name (e.g., PAINS, Glaxo, GSK...) if present
  set_name_col <- nms[grep("rule.?set.?name|set_name|ruleset_name|rule_set_name", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # rule_id numeric
  id_col <- nms[grep("^rule.?id$|rule_id", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # description/name field (human readable), best-effort
  desc_col <- nms[grep("description|desc|name|alert_name|label", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  if (is.na(smarts_col) || is.na(id_col) || (is.na(rule_set_col) && is.na(set_name_col))) {
    stop(
      "Could not detect required columns in alert CSV. Found columns: ",
      paste(nms, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
 
  # ---- Normalize ----
  alerts <- dplyr::as_tibble(al) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      rule_set      = if (!is.na(rule_set_col)) as.integer(.data[[rule_set_col]]) else NA_integer_,
      rule_set_name = if (!is.na(set_name_col)) as.character(.data[[set_name_col]]) else NA_character_,
      rule_id       = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[id_col]])),
      description   = if (!is.na(desc_col)) as.character(.data[[desc_col]]) else NA_character_,
      smarts        = as.character(.data[[smarts_col]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(smarts), nzchar(smarts)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rule_id)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # if rule_set_name missing, fall back to rule_set as text
      rule_set_name = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(rule_set_name) | !nzchar(rule_set_name),
        ifelse(!is.na(rule_set), paste0("RuleSet_", rule_set), "UnknownSet"),
        rule_set_name
      ),
      # stable ID uses numeric rule_set if available; else build stable-ish id from set_name
      alert_id = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(rule_set),
        paste0(rule_set, ":", rule_id),
        paste0(rule_set_name, ":", rule_id)
      ),
      # human-readable label
      label = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(description) & nzchar(description),
        paste0(alert_id, " | ", rule_set_name, " | ", description),
        paste0(alert_id, " | ", rule_set_name)
      )
    )
 
  # ---- Split and compile patterns ----
  split(alerts, alerts$rule_set_name) %>%
    purrr::map(function(d) {
      tibble::tibble(
        rule_set_name = d$rule_set_name[1],
        rule_set      = d$rule_set[1],
        rule_id       = d$rule_id,
        alert_id      = d$alert_id,
        description   = d$description,
        smarts        = d$smarts,
        label         = d$label,
        patt          = purrr::map(d$smarts, ~ tryCatch(Chem$MolFromSmarts(.x), error = function(e) NULL))
      ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!purrr::map_lgl(patt, is.null))
    })
}
 
compiled_sets <- get_alerts()
 
flag_molecule <- function(smi, compiled_sets) {
  mol <- safe_mol(smi)
  if (is.null(mol)) return("")
  
  hits <- c()
  
  for (set_name in names(compiled_sets)) {
    tbl <- compiled_sets[[set_name]]
    
    matched <- purrr::map_lgl(tbl$patt, ~ mol$HasSubstructMatch(.x))
    
    if (any(matched)) {
      hits <- c(hits, tbl$label[matched])
    }
  }
  
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    ""
  } else {
    paste(unique(hits), collapse = " | ")
  }
}
 
 
calc_lipinski <- function(smi) {
  mol <- safe_mol(smi)
  if (is.null(mol)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(MW = NA_real_, LogP = NA_real_, HBD = NA_real_, 
                          HBA = NA_real_, Lipinski = NA_character_, 
                          Lipinski_Passed = NA_character_, Lipinski_Failed = NA_character_))
  }
  
  MW <- as.numeric(Desc$MolWt(mol))
  LogP <- as.numeric(Crip$MolLogP(mol))
  HBD <- as.numeric(Lip$NumHDonors(mol))
  HBA <- as.numeric(Lip$NumHAcceptors(mol))
  
  passed <- c(
    if (!is.na(MW) && MW <= 500) "MW<=500",
    if (!is.na(LogP) && LogP <= 5) "LogP<=5",
    if (!is.na(HBD) && HBD <= 5) "HBD<=5",
    if (!is.na(HBA) && HBA <= 10) "HBA<=10"
  )
  
  failed <- c(
    if (!is.na(MW) && MW > 500) "MW>500",
    if (!is.na(LogP) && LogP > 5) "LogP>5",
    if (!is.na(HBD) && HBD > 5) "HBD>5",
    if (!is.na(HBA) && HBA > 10) "HBA>10"
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    MW = MW, LogP = LogP, HBD = HBD, HBA = HBA,
    Lipinski = if (length(failed) == 0) "Pass" else "Fail",
    Lipinski_Passed = paste(passed, collapse = ", "),
    Lipinski_Failed = paste(failed, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 6) Compute properties for unique SMILES
# ============================================================
unique_smiles <- df_hits %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMILES_used), SMILES_used != "") %>%
  distinct(SMILES_used)
 
cat("Computing properties for", nrow(unique_smiles), "unique SMILES...\n")
smis <- unique_smiles$SMILES_used
n <- length(smis)
 
pb <- progress::progress_bar$new(
  format = "RDKit [:bar] :current/:total :percent | eta: :eta",
  total  = n,
  clear  = FALSE,
  width  = 60
)
 
properties_list <- vector("list", n)
 
for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  pb$tick()
 
  smi <- smis[i]
 
  flags <- flag_molecule(smi, compiled_sets)
  props <- calc_lipinski(smi)
 
  properties_list[[i]] <- cbind(
    tibble::tibble(SMILES_used = smi, alert_flags = flags),
    props
  )
}
 
properties_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(properties_list)
 
# ============================================================
# 7) Join properties and calculate risk scores
# ============================================================
# Chemical Liability Scoring Framework (Max-Based Tier System)
#
# This scoring system assigns compounds to liability tiers based on the
# highest-severity flag present rather than summing penalties. This avoids
# artificial inflation when multiple related alerts are triggered.
# The PAINS/MLSMR/BMS/GSK/Glaxo/LINT/Dundee/Inpharmatica/SureChEMBL are based on the the ChEMBL database and Pat Walters work.
# See https://github.com/PatWalters/rd_filters.git
 
# Tier definitions:
 
#   Score 10 (ELEVATED):
#     - PAINS compounds 
#     - Cytotoxicity (≥25% viability loss)
#
#   Score 5 (MODERATE):
#     - Industry structural alerts (MLSMR / NIH structural alerts, BMS, GSK, Glaxo, LINT, Dundee)
#     - tdTomato reporter suppression (≥25% loss)
#
#   Score 2 (MINOR):
#     - Lipinski rule-of-five violations
#     - Inpharmatica / SureChEMBL alerts
 
# Risk categories:
#   10  -> "ELEVATED"
#   5   -> "MODERATE"
#   2   -> "MINOR"
#   0   -> "CLEAN"
 
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
df_final <- df_hits %>%
  left_join(properties_tbl, by = "SMILES_used", suffix = c(".old", "")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".old")) %>%
  mutate(
    Viability = if ("Viability" %in% names(.)) Viability else NA_real_,
    TdTomato = if ("tdTomato_Diff" %in% names(.)) {
    tdTomato_Diff <= -25 &
      if ("residual" %in% names(.)) is.na(residual) else TRUE
  } else FALSE,
    
 
    Cytotoxic = !is.na(Viability) & (Viability <= -25),
 
    has_smiles = !is.na(SMILES_used) & nzchar(trimws(SMILES_used)),
    flags = if_else(has_smiles, coalesce(alert_flags, ""), ""),
 
    # --- Flag categories ---
    High_Flag = grepl("PAINS", flags, ignore.case = TRUE) | Cytotoxic,
 
    Moderate_Flag = grepl("BMS|GLAXO|GSK|LINT|DUNDEE|MLSMR|NIH", flags, ignore.case = TRUE) | TdTomato,
 
    Mild_Flag = grepl("INPHARMATICA|SURECHEMBL", flags, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                (!is.na(Lipinski_Failed) & Lipinski_Failed > 0),
 
    # --- Max-based score ---
    AlertScore = pmax(
      if_else(High_Flag, 10L, 0L),
      if_else(Moderate_Flag, 5L, 0L),
      if_else(Mild_Flag, 2L, 0L)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Risk = case_when(
      !has_smiles        ~ "UNKNOWN",
      AlertScore >= 10   ~ "ELEVATED",
      AlertScore >= 5    ~ "MODERATE",
      AlertScore >= 2    ~ "MINOR",
      TRUE               ~ "CLEAN"
    )
  )
 
 
chem_cols_chr <- c("flags", "Lipinski", "Lipinski_Failed")
chem_cols_num <- c("AlertScore", "MW", "LogP", "HBD", "HBA")
chem_cols_lgl <- c("PAINS_NIH_Flagged", "Industry_Flagged", "Other_Flagged")
 
df_final <- df_final %>%
  mutate(
    across(any_of(chem_cols_num), ~ if_else(has_smiles, .x, NA_real_)),
    across(any_of(chem_cols_chr), ~ if_else(has_smiles, .x, NA_character_)),
    across(any_of(chem_cols_lgl), ~ if_else(has_smiles, .x, NA))
  ) %>%
  select(-has_smiles)
 
 
#Select important columns for exporting:
df_final <- df_final %>%
  select(any_of(c(
    "Reference", "Plate", "Well",
    "BZScore", "ZScore", "BScore", "PercentEffect",
    "Viability", "Risk", "PlateZPrimeScore", "Systematic_error", "QC_alpha",
    "AvgFoci", "Average_foci_perCell", "CellCount", "CellCountPercentDiff",
    "AssayType", "TdTomato", "residual", "Cytotoxic",
    "CAS", "SMILES_used", "MW", "LogP", "HBD", "HBA", "Lipinski", "Lipinski_Failed",
    "AlertScore", "alert_flags"
  )))
# ============================================================
# 8) Write back to Excel
# ============================================================
 
#Overwrite previous hits sheet in original workbook to add chemical triage labels:
 
sheet_hits <- "Hits"
 
# (optional) make factors safe for Excel
df_final <- df_final %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
 
# 2) Load the existing workbook and overwrite the Hits sheet
wb <- loadWorkbook(fileX)
 
 
if (sheet_hits %in% names(wb)) removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
addWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
 
#Order by BZ-Score (descending)
df_final <- df_final %>% arrange(desc(if ("BZScore" %in% names(.)) BZScore else ZScore))
writeData(wb, sheet_hits, df_final, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
 
freezePane(wb, sheet_hits, firstActiveRow = 2)
addFilter(wb, sheet_hits, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_final))
 
# Desired sheets (in order)
new_order <- c("Hits", "Combined Analysis", "Plate Statistics", "Controls")
 
# Remove unwanted sheets
for (sh in setdiff(names(wb), new_order)) {
  removeWorksheet(wb, sh)
}
 
# Reorder by matching positions
worksheetOrder(wb) <- match(new_order, names(wb))
 
 
saveWorkbook(wb, fileX, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# RDKit imports
rdkit       <- import("rdkit")
Chem        <- rdkit$Chem
AllChem     <- rdkit$Chem$AllChem
DataStructs <- rdkit$DataStructs
Draw        <- import("rdkit.Chem.Draw")
MolDrawing  <- import("rdkit.Chem.Draw.rdMolDraw2D")
 
# ── Output directory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir <- save_Location
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
 
# ── Restrict Tanimoto/cheminformatics analysis to confirmed hits ────────────────
# Only compounds with BZ/Z-Score > 3 that pass viability (Viability >= -50) and,
# if a tdTomato channel exists, pass the tdTomato filter. This mirrors the
# viab_ok / td_ok conventions used elsewhere (TdTomato here is the "failed"
# drop flag, so passing == !TdTomato).
score_col_chem <- if ("BZScore" %in% names(df_final)) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
 
df_chem <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    .data[[score_col_chem]] > 3,
    is.na(Viability) | Viability >= -50,
    if (has_td_int && "TdTomato" %in% names(.)) (is.na(TdTomato) | !TdTomato) else TRUE
  )
 
message("Cheminformatics: ", nrow(df_chem), " of ", nrow(df_final),
        " hits pass BZ/Z>3, viability, and tdTomato filters.")
 
# ── Molecular Fingerprinting ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fps <- lapply(df_chem$SMILES_used, function(smi) {
  mol <- Chem$MolFromSmiles(smi)
  if (is.null(mol)) return(NULL)
  AllChem$GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(mol, radius = 2L, nBits = 2048L)
})
valid <- !sapply(fps, is.null)
fps   <- fps[valid]
refs  <- df_chem$Reference[valid]
 
 
# ── Tanimoto similarity matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
n <- length(fps)
sim_matrix <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(refs, refs))
for (i in seq_len(n))
  for (j in seq_len(n))
    sim_matrix[i, j] <- DataStructs$TanimotoSimilarity(fps[[i]], fps[[j]])
 
# ── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
diverging_owp    <- colorRampPalette(c("#E87D3E", "#F5C9A0", "white", "#9B8EC4", "#3B2A6E"))(100)
sequential_pdark <- colorRampPalette(c("#F5D0D8", "#C98BAA", "#7B3F7A", "#3A1050", "#0F0318"))(100)
bar_fill         <- "darkgray"
umap_colors <- c("NT Ctrl" = "#F4A8B0", "RNF26" = "#F5C89A", "ZNF335" = "#C8B8E0")
 
# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_legend <- function(ref, hits_df) {
  row <- hits_df %>% filter(Reference == ref)
  paste0(ref, " | Effect:", sprintf("%.1f", row$PercentEffect),
         " | td:", sprintf("%.1f", row$tdTomato_Diff))
}
strip_name <- function(mol) { mol$SetProp("_Name", ""); mol }
 
opts <- MolDrawing$MolDrawOptions()
opts$legendFontSize <- 22L
opts$legendFraction <- 0.15
opts$padding        <- 0.05
 
# ── Mol objects ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mols       <- lapply(df_chem$SMILES_used, function(smi) Chem$MolFromSmiles(smi))
valid_mol  <- !sapply(mols, is.null)
mols_valid <- mols[valid_mol]
refs_valid <- df_chem$Reference[valid_mol]
 
#------------------------
#Figure Generation:
#------------------------
# Turn whatever MolsToGridImage returns into a PNG file on disk
grid_png_to_file <- function(obj, path) {
  if (is.raw(obj)) { writeBin(obj, path); return(invisible(path)) }
  rawc <- tryCatch(reticulate::py_to_r(obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.raw(rawc)) { writeBin(rawc, path); return(invisible(path)) }
  if (inherits(obj, "python.builtin.bytes")) {            # your case: write via Python
    bi  <- reticulate::import_builtins()
    con <- bi$open(path, "wb"); con$write(obj); con$close()
    return(invisible(path))
  }
  if (!is.null(tryCatch(obj$save, error = function(e) NULL))) {  # PIL Image fallback
    obj$save(path); return(invisible(path))
  }
  stop("Unrecognized MolsToGridImage return: ", paste(class(obj), collapse = ", "))
}
# ── Structural clustering (Butina / Taylor-Butina) ──────────────────────────────
# Butina clustering greedily picks centroids with the most neighbors within the
# distance cutoff, giving compact, centroid-based clusters. This is more
# defensible than a simple similarity-threshold graph (igraph::components),
# which performs single-linkage clustering and can chain compounds together
# transitively even when the endpoints aren't very similar to each other.
# Computed up-front (before the MDS plot) so cluster membership can be used
# to color the MDS scatter.
Butina <- import("rdkit.ML.Cluster.Butina")
 
# Tanimoto DISTANCE cutoff (1 - similarity). 0.6 distance == 0.4 similarity,
# matching the threshold used previously.
cluster_cutoff <- 0.7
 
n_chem <- length(refs_valid)
if (n_chem >= 2) {
  dist_vec <- numeric(n_chem * (n_chem - 1) / 2)
  k <- 1L
  for (i in 2:n_chem) {
    for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
      dist_vec[k] <- 1 - sim_matrix[i, j]
      k <- k + 1L
    }
  }
} else {
  dist_vec <- numeric(0)
}
 
butina_clusters <- Butina$ClusterData(dist_vec, n_chem, cluster_cutoff, isDistData = TRUE)
 
# The first index in each Butina tuple is the cluster centroid (the compound
# with the most neighbors within the cutoff) -- a natural structural
# representative for that cluster.
cluster_all_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(butina_clusters), function(g) {
  idx <- unlist(butina_clusters[[g]]) + 1L  # python 0-based -> R 1-based
  data.frame(
    Reference      = refs_valid[idx],
    Group          = g,
    Representative = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, length(idx) - 1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})) %>% arrange(Group)
 
# Multi-compound clusters only, for the IMAGE 5 structure grid
component_df <- cluster_all_df %>%
  group_by(Group) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(Group)
 
cluster_summary <- component_df %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), compounds = paste(Reference, collapse = ", "))
 
# ── IMAGE 1: Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#Convert from similarity to distance matrix for heatmap clustering:
tanimoto_dist <- as.dist(1 - sim_matrix)
 
png(file.path(out_dir, "tanimoto_heatmap.png"), width = 2800, height = 2400, res = 300)
pheatmap(sim_matrix,                        # still display the similarity values
         clustering_distance_rows = tanimoto_dist,
         clustering_distance_cols = tanimoto_dist,
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         color = diverging_owp,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         fontsize_row = 5,
         fontsize_col = 5)
dev.off()
 
# ── IMAGE 2: Similarity distribution ──────────────────────────────────────────
sim_vals <- melt(sim_matrix) %>% filter(Var1 != Var2)
p_dist <- ggplot(sim_vals, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = bar_fill, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", color = "#E87D3E") +
  labs(title = "Pairwise Tanimoto Similarity Distribution",
       x = "Tanimoto Similarity", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tanimoto_distribution.png"), p_dist, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
 
# ── IMAGE 3: MDS (PCoA) scatter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# UMAP is unstable/unreliable for small N. Classical MDS (cmdscale) on the
# Tanimoto distance matrix is deterministic and behaves sensibly at any N.
# Column names kept as UMAP1/UMAP2/umap_df to avoid disrupting the Excel export.
dist_matrix <- 1 - sim_matrix
n_items     <- nrow(dist_matrix)
 
if (n_items >= 3) {
  mds_res <- cmdscale(as.dist(dist_matrix), k = min(2L, n_items - 1L))
 
  if (ncol(mds_res) < 2) mds_res <- cbind(mds_res, 0)  # guard for k=1 edge case
 
  umap_df <- data.frame(UMAP1 = mds_res[, 1],
                         UMAP2 = mds_res[, 2],
                         Reference = rownames(sim_matrix))
  p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = Reference)) +
    geom_point(color = bar_fill, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "MDS (PCoA) of Chemical Fingerprint Similarity",
         x = "MDS1", y = "MDS2")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "umap_scatter.png"), p_umap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
} else {
  message("Too few compounds (", n_items, ") for a meaningful MDS plot -- skipping plot.")
  umap_df <- data.frame(UMAP1 = NA_real_, UMAP2 = NA_real_,
                        Reference = rownames(sim_matrix))   # keeps the Excel sheet working
}
 
# ── IMAGE 3b: MDS scatter colored by structural (Butina) cluster ───────────────
# Same MDS embedding as IMAGE 3, but colored by Butina cluster membership so
# you can see at a glance which hits are structurally related. Singletons
# (clusters of size 1) are grouped into a single "Unclustered" category and
# shown in gray so the discrete color scale isn't dominated by one-off groups.
if (n_items >= 3 && exists("cluster_all_df")) {
  cluster_sizes <- cluster_all_df %>% count(Group)
  multi_groups  <- cluster_sizes$Group[cluster_sizes$n > 1]
 
  umap_cluster_df <- umap_df %>%
    left_join(cluster_all_df %>% select(Reference, Group), by = "Reference") %>%
    mutate(
      ClusterLabel = if_else(Group %in% multi_groups,
                              paste0("Cluster ", Group),
                              "Unclustered")
    )
 
  # Stable color assignment: real clusters get the qualitative palette,
  # "Unclustered" is always gray regardless of how many clusters exist.
  named_levels <- sort(unique(umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel[umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel != "Unclustered"]))
  cluster_levels <- c(named_levels, "Unclustered")
 
  cluster_colors <- if (length(named_levels) > 0) scales::hue_pal()(length(named_levels)) else character(0)
  cluster_palette <- setNames(c(cluster_colors, "gray70"), cluster_levels)
 
  umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel <- factor(umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel, levels = cluster_levels)
 
  p_umap_clusters <- ggplot(umap_cluster_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = Reference, color = ClusterLabel)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_palette) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "MDS (PCoA) Colored by Structural Cluster (Butina)",
         x = "MDS1", y = "MDS2", color = "Cluster")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "mds_scatter_clusters.png"), p_umap_clusters, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 150)
} else {
  message("Skipping cluster-colored MDS plot (too few compounds or no cluster data).")
}
 
# ── IMAGE 4: All hits structure grid ──────────────────────────────────────────
legends_all <- sapply(refs_valid, make_legend, hits_df = df_merged)
mols_clean  <- lapply(mols_valid, strip_name)
 
img_obj <- Draw$MolsToGridImage(mols_clean, molsPerRow = 6L, subImgSize = c(600L, 500L),
                                legends = as.list(unname(legends_all)),
                                drawOptions = opts, returnPNG = TRUE)
#writeBin(grid_png_raw(img_obj), file.path(out_dir, "hits_structures.png"))
grid_png_to_file(img_obj, file.path(out_dir, "hits_structures.png"))
 
# ── IMAGE 5: One row per cluster, structures + text separated via magick ───────
library(magick)
 
 
groups_unique <- sort(unique(component_df$Group))
 
groups_unique <- sort(unique(component_df$Group))
 
if (length(groups_unique) == 0) {
  message("No multi-compound clusters (Tanimoto > 0.4) -- skipping grouped structure grid.")
} else {
 
  # image_annotate() runs text through ImageMagick's MVG "text" primitive,
  # which can choke on quotes/percent signs/newlines in compound names and
  # throw "non-conforming drawing primitive definition `text'". Side-step
  # that entirely by rendering text with base R graphics (png + text()) and
  # reading the result back in as an image. Defined here (shared scope) so
  # both the per-compound text panels and the cluster banners can use it.
  safe_text <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT", sub = "")
    gsub("[\r\n\t]", " ", x)
  }
 
  make_banner <- function(text, width_px, height_px = 50) {
    tmp_banner <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
 
    png(tmp_banner, width = width_px, height = height_px, bg = "#EDE9F5", res = 120)
    par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
    plot.new()
    plot.window(xlim = c(0, width_px), ylim = c(height_px, 0))
 
    text(x = 16, y = height_px / 2, labels = safe_text(text), adj = c(0, 0.5),
         cex = 1.6, col = "#3B2A6E", font = 2, family = "sans")
 
    dev.off()
    image_read(tmp_banner)
  }
 
  cluster_images <- lapply(groups_unique, function(grp) {
 
    # ── Compounds in this cluster ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    refs_in_grp <- component_df$Reference[component_df$Group == grp]
    idx_in_grp  <- match(refs_in_grp, refs_valid)
    valid_idx   <- !is.na(idx_in_grp)
    refs_in_grp <- refs_in_grp[valid_idx]
    idx_in_grp  <- idx_in_grp[valid_idx]
    n_in_grp    <- length(refs_in_grp)
 
    # ── 1. Draw structures with no legend ──────────────────────────────────────
    mols_grp   <- lapply(mols_valid[idx_in_grp], strip_name)
    blank_legs <- as.list(rep("", n_in_grp))
 
    struct_obj <- Draw$MolsToGridImage(mols_grp, molsPerRow = as.integer(n_in_grp),
                                       subImgSize = c(600L, 500L), legends = blank_legs,
                                       drawOptions = opts, returnPNG = TRUE)
    tmp_png    <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    grid_png_to_file(struct_obj, tmp_png)
    struct_img <- image_read(tmp_png)
    struct_w   <- image_info(struct_img)$width
    cell_w     <- as.integer(struct_w / n_in_grp)
 
    # ── 2. Build text panel for each compound ──────────────────────────────────
    make_text_panel <- function(lines, width_px, height_px, fontsize = 22) {
      tmp_txt <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
 
      png(tmp_txt, width = width_px, height = height_px, bg = "white", res = 120)
      par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
      plot.new()
      plot.window(xlim = c(0, width_px), ylim = c(height_px, 0))
 
      y <- 28
      for (ln in lines) {
        text(x = 20, y = y, labels = safe_text(ln), adj = c(0, 0),
             cex = fontsize / 18, col = "#222222", family = "sans")
        y <- y + 30
      }
 
      dev.off()
      image_read(tmp_txt)
    }
 
    text_panels <- lapply(seq_len(n_in_grp), function(i) {
      ref <- refs_in_grp[i]
      row <- df_merged %>% filter(Reference == ref) %>% slice(1)
 
      eff_val <- if ("PercentEffect" %in% names(row)) row$PercentEffect[1] else NA_real_
      td_val  <- if ("tdTomato_Diff" %in% names(row)) row$tdTomato_Diff[1] else NA_real_
 
      others    <- setdiff(seq_len(n_in_grp), i)
      tan_lines <- sapply(others, function(j) {
        t_val <- DataStructs$TanimotoSimilarity(fps[[idx_in_grp[i]]], fps[[idx_in_grp[j]]])
        sprintf("  vs %s:  %.2f", refs_in_grp[j], t_val)
      })
 
      lines <- c(
        ref,
        sprintf("Eff: %.1f  |  td: %.1f", eff_val, td_val),
        strrep("-", 20),
        "Tanimoto:",
        tan_lines
      )
      panel_h <- 40 + length(lines) * 30
 
      make_text_panel(lines = lines, width_px = cell_w, height_px = panel_h, fontsize = 22)
    })
 
    # ── 3. Stitch text panels side by side ─────────────────────────────────────
    text_row <- image_append(do.call(c, text_panels), stack = FALSE)
    text_w   <- image_info(text_row)$width
    if (text_w < struct_w) {
      text_row <- image_extent(text_row,
                               geometry = paste0(struct_w, "x", image_info(text_row)$height),
                               gravity = "West", color = "white")
    }
 
    # ── 4. Stack structures on top of text ─────────────────────────────────────
    image_append(c(struct_img, text_row), stack = TRUE)
  })
 
  # ── Banners + stack all rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  max_width  <- max(sapply(cluster_images, function(img) image_info(img)$width))
  final_rows <- lapply(seq_along(cluster_images), function(i) {
    grp <- groups_unique[i]
    n   <- sum(component_df$Group == grp)
    img <- cluster_images[[i]]
 
    if (image_info(img)$width < max_width) {
      img <- image_extent(img, geometry = paste0(max_width, "x", image_info(img)$height),
                          gravity = "West", color = "white")
    }
 
    banner <- make_banner(text = sprintf("Cluster %d  (%d compounds)", grp, n),
                          width_px = max_width, height_px = 50)
 
    image_append(c(banner, img), stack = TRUE)
  })
 
  final_img <- image_append(do.call(c, final_rows), stack = TRUE)
  image_write(final_img, file.path(out_dir, "hits_structures_grouped.png"))
  message("Saved: hits_structures_grouped.png")
}
# ── EXCEL EXPORT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb <- createWorkbook()
 
header_style    <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, fontColour = "white",
                               fgFill = "#3B2A6E", halign = "center",
                               textDecoration = "bold", border = "Bottom")
cell_style      <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0.0000",
                               halign = "center", border = "LeftRight", borderColour = "#CCCCCC")
cell_style_text <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, halign = "left")
cell_style_num  <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0.0000", halign = "right")
cell_style_int  <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0", halign = "center")
 
# ── Sheet 1: Tanimoto Similarity Matrix ───────────────────────────────────────
addWorksheet(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity")
sim_df <- cbind(Reference = rownames(sim_matrix), as.data.frame(sim_matrix))
rownames(sim_df) <- NULL
writeData(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", sim_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
n_rows <- nrow(sim_df); n_cols <- ncol(sim_df)
conditionalFormatting(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", cols = 2:n_cols, rows = 2:(n_rows + 1),
                      style = c("#FFFFFF", "#7B3F7A"), rule = c(0, 1), type = "colourScale")
addStyle(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", style = cell_style,
         rows = 2:(n_rows + 1), cols = 2:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", style = cell_style_text,
         rows = 2:(n_rows + 1), cols = 1, gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", cols = 1,
             widths = max(nchar(as.character(sim_df$Reference))) * 1.2 + 2)
setColWidths(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", cols = 2:n_cols, widths = 10)
freezePane(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", firstRow = TRUE, firstCol = TRUE)
 
# ── Sheet 2: UMAP Results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
addWorksheet(wb, "UMAP Results")
writeData(wb, "UMAP Results", umap_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
n_umap_rows <- nrow(umap_df)
addStyle(wb, "UMAP Results", style = cell_style_text,
         rows = 2:(n_umap_rows + 1), cols = 1, gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "UMAP Results", style = cell_style_num,
         rows = 2:(n_umap_rows + 1), cols = 2:3, gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(wb, "UMAP Results", cols = 1, widths = 25)
setColWidths(wb, "UMAP Results", cols = 2:3, widths = 14)
freezePane(wb, "UMAP Results", firstRow = TRUE, firstCol = FALSE)
 
# ── Sheet 3: Cluster Assignments ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Includes ALL Butina clusters (singletons too), plus:
#   - Representative: structural centroid of the cluster (most neighbors within
#     the Tanimoto distance cutoff)
#   - Score: BZ/Z-Score (whichever applies) for the compound
#   - Hit: TRUE if the compound's Score exceeds 3 (Z- or BZ-Score, whichever
#     column applies for this run).
addWorksheet(wb, "Clusters")
cluster_export <- cluster_all_df %>%
  left_join(df_merged %>% select(any_of(c("Reference", "PercentEffect", "tdTomato_Diff"))), by = "Reference") %>%
  left_join(df_chem %>% select(Reference, Score = all_of(score_col_chem)), by = "Reference") %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(Hit = Score > 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Score))
cluster_export$Group <- as.integer(cluster_export$Group)
writeData(wb, "Clusters", cluster_export, startRow = 1, startCol = 1,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
n_cluster_rows  <- nrow(cluster_export)
n_cluster_cols  <- ncol(cluster_export)
cluster_colnames <- names(cluster_export)
 
# Numeric columns vary depending on whether tdTomato_Diff exists for this run
numeric_cols <- match(intersect(c("PercentEffect", "tdTomato_Diff", "Score"), cluster_colnames),
                       cluster_colnames)
 
addStyle(wb, "Clusters", style = cell_style_text,
         rows = 2:(n_cluster_rows + 1), cols = match("Reference", cluster_colnames), gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Clusters", style = cell_style_int,
         rows = 2:(n_cluster_rows + 1), cols = match("Group", cluster_colnames), gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Clusters", style = cell_style_num,
         rows = 2:(n_cluster_rows + 1), cols = numeric_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
 
 
 
# Alternating row shading by cluster group
groups <- cluster_export$Group
for (i in seq_len(n_cluster_rows)) {
  if (groups[i] %% 2 == 0)
    addStyle(wb, "Clusters", rows = i + 1, cols = 1:n_cluster_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE,
             style = createStyle(fgFill = "#EDE9F5", fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10))
}
 
summary_start_col <- n_cluster_cols + 2
writeData(wb, "Clusters", cluster_summary, startRow = 1, startCol = summary_start_col,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Reference", cluster_colnames), widths = 25)
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Group", cluster_colnames), widths = 10)
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = numeric_cols, widths = 14)
if ("Representative" %in% cluster_colnames)
  setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Representative", cluster_colnames), widths = 14)
if ("Hit" %in% cluster_colnames)
  setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Hit", cluster_colnames), widths = 10)
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = summary_start_col:(summary_start_col + 2), widths = c(10, 8, 40))
freezePane(wb, "Clusters", firstRow = TRUE)
 
# ── Save workbook ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(out_dir, "cheminformatics_results.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
 
message("Export complete:")
message("  Images: tanimoto_heatmap.png, tanimoto_distribution.png, pca_scatter.png,")
message("umap_scatter.png, hits_structures.png, hits_structures_grouped.png")
message("  Excel:  cheminformatics_results.xlsx (3 sheets: Tanimoto Similarity, UMAP Results, Clusters)")
```
 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# FINAL: Export Hits + QC + Chemical Filtering (consolidated)
# ============================================================
# The cheminformatics chunk above ends by deleting every worksheet not in
# c("Hits","Combined Analysis","Plate Statistics","Controls") -- which wipes
# out "Export Hits" (written in the NORMALIZED SCORE PLOT chunk) and "Hits_QC"
# (written in the spatial-QC chunk), even though both still exist as R objects
# (export_hits_df, hits_df_qc). This chunk restores those two sheets and adds a
# third: "Export Hits Annotated", which is export_hits_df left-joined with the
# spatial-QC flags and the chemical-filtering report, restricted to the wells
# that made it into Export Hits, for one-stop downstream triage.
 
if (exists("export_hits_df") && exists("fileX") && file.exists(fileX)) {
 
  # Spatial QC columns, keyed on Plate/Well (Hits_QC is derived from the
  # "Combined Analysis" sheet via hit_threshold, a different/looser cut than
  # Export Hits, so this is a left join -- not every Export Hits row will have
  # a QC match, and that's fine: NA here just means "not flagged by spatial QC").
  qc_cols <- if (exists("hits_df_qc")) {
    hits_df_qc %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
      select(any_of(c("Plate", "Well", "Type_of_Error", "Systematic_error",
                       "QC_alpha", "QC_well_fold_threshold", "QC_score_outlier_sd"))) %>%
      distinct(Plate, Well, .keep_all = TRUE)
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(Plate = character(), Well = character())
  }
 
  # Chemical-filtering columns, keyed on Plate/Well (df_final is the "Hits"
  # sheet -- BZ/Z >= 3 -- enriched with SMILES/Lipinski/structural-alert risk).
  chem_cols <- if (exists("df_final")) {
    df_final %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
      select(any_of(c("Plate", "Well", "Risk", "AlertScore", "alert_flags",
                       "MW", "LogP", "HBD", "HBA", "Lipinski", "Lipinski_Failed",
                       "CAS", "SMILES_used", "TdTomato", "Cytotoxic"))) %>%
      distinct(Plate, Well, .keep_all = TRUE)
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(Plate = character(), Well = character())
  }
 
  export_hits_annotated <- export_hits_df %>%
    left_join(qc_cols,   by = c("Plate", "Well")) %>%
    left_join(chem_cols, by = c("Plate", "Well")) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[score_col]]))
 
  wb_final <- loadWorkbook(fileX)
 
  # Re-add "Export Hits" / "Hits_QC" (removed by the cheminformatics cleanup
  # step) to the main workbook. The consolidated "Export Hits Annotated"
  # table goes into its own standalone workbook (see below), not in here.
  for (s in c("Export Hits", "Hits_QC", "TriagedHits")) {
    if (s %in% names(wb_final)) removeWorksheet(wb_final, s)
  }
 
  addWorksheet(wb_final, "Export Hits")
  writeData(wb_final, "Export Hits", export_hits_df, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb_final, "Export Hits", firstActiveRow = 2)
  addFilter(wb_final, "Export Hits", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(export_hits_df))
 
  if (exists("hits_df_qc")) {
    hits_qc_out <- hits_df_qc %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
    addWorksheet(wb_final, "Hits_QC")
    writeData(wb_final, "Hits_QC", hits_qc_out)
    freezePane(wb_final, "Hits_QC", firstRow = TRUE)
    addFilter(wb_final, "Hits_QC", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(hits_qc_out))
  }
 
  # Also add the consolidated Export Hits + QC + chemical-filtering table as
  # its own sheet in the main workbook (same content as the standalone
  # "_ExportHitsAnnotated.xlsx" workbook written below).
  addWorksheet(wb_final, "TriagedHits")
  writeData(wb_final, "TriagedHits", export_hits_annotated, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb_final, "TriagedHits", firstActiveRow = 2)
  addFilter(wb_final, "TriagedHits", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(export_hits_annotated))
 
  # Keep "TriagedHits"/"Export Hits"/"Hits_QC" up front, everything else in a sensible order.
  final_order <- c("TriagedHits", "Export Hits", "Hits_QC",
                    "Hits", "Combined Analysis", "Plate Statistics", "Controls")
  final_order <- c(final_order[final_order %in% names(wb_final)],
                    setdiff(names(wb_final), final_order))
  worksheetOrder(wb_final) <- match(final_order, names(wb_final))
 
  saveWorkbook(wb_final, fileX, overwrite = TRUE)
 
  # --- Standalone "Export Hits Annotated" workbook -------------------------
  # A brand-new spreadsheet whose primary table is export_hits_annotated:
  # the Export Hits rows, left-joined with spatial-QC flags and the chemical-
  # filtering report, restricted to wells that made it into Export Hits.
  annotated_file <- file.path(
    dirname(fileX),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fileX)), "_ExportHitsAnnotated.xlsx")
  )
 
  wb_annotated <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb_annotated, "Export Hits Annotated")
  writeData(wb_annotated, "Export Hits Annotated", export_hits_annotated, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb_annotated, "Export Hits Annotated", firstActiveRow = 2)
  addFilter(wb_annotated, "Export Hits Annotated", rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(export_hits_annotated))
 
  saveWorkbook(wb_annotated, annotated_file, overwrite = TRUE)
 
  cat("Export Hits Annotated workbook written:", annotated_file, "--",
      nrow(export_hits_annotated),
      "rows (Export Hits joined with spatial-QC flags and chemical-filtering report)\n")
 
} else {
  message("Skipping consolidated Export Hits sheet: export_hits_df or fileX not found in this session.")
}
```
